jobs.description:
**CBM Vyndaqel & Ngenla**

**CBM I&I Dermatology**

**CBM Nurtec / Rimegepant**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

**The role partners with category and market leaders** to convert portfolio strategy into robust launch plans, stronger brand choices and scalable, insight-led ways of working.

Leads the implementation and execution of all marketing and promotional activities for the allocated brands and/or portfolio of therapy area throughout the product(s) life cycle with the main objective of ensuring that the best strategies, tools, materials and communication channels are made available to all customer facing colleagues. The CBM will be working closely with cross function teams to ensure the delivery of the marketing goals in alignment with the company’s goals and strategies.

**CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**1. BRAND/ TA/ CHANNEL MANAGEMENT AND TACTICAL PLAN DEVELOPMENT**

* Collecting market insights to help in strategy development
* Development of local tactics (tactical plan), promotional campaigns and programs to maximize brand value
* Implementation of local strategy and alignment with regional and global strategies as appropriate
* Provide accurate analysis of data for each brand and/ or portfolio to support proposed strategy
* Ensure the brands/ TAs are being managed according to life cycle requirements
* Take responsibility for brand requirements in the various channels and deliver the correct content to fulfill the promotional requirements, within those channels
* Identify plans and implement core materials in line with the tactical plan (supporting the channel strategies)
* Work closely with cross-functional brand leadership through the core brand team
* Utilize inputs from the core brand team to support the strategy and tactical development
* Take accountability for ensuring that all content and/or promotion materials and items for promotional purposes used by customer facing colleagues and channel activities are delivered timeously
* Complete the demand planning with GSCPM, to ensure continued stock supply to markets and avoid stock obsolescence

**2. FINANCIAL PLANNING**

* Deliver on revenues and IBA of brands/portfolio within the scope of management
* Ensure high integrity and accuracy of forecasts
* Ensure mitigation plans are developed, as required
* Monthly brand and portfolio reviews with CBL/Category Lead
* Work with GSCPM to optimize brand forecasts and reduce obsolescence
* Set up, monitor and track ROI of marketing expenditure and programs
* Optimally Managing and controlling A&P to maximize the marketing impact

**3. ALIGNMENT ACROSS FUNCTIONS AND STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT**

* Align key internal stakeholders, through the core brand team – medical, marketing, Access, regulatory, sales etc – to drive business objectives, develop strategies and tactics for the brand and/ or TA
* Lead the efforts to understand and address country opportunities and challenges
* Collaborate with sales to roll out and drive effective execution of campaigns and programs
* Establish effective peer relationships and strong cross-functional collaboration and communication
* Establish and maintain positive relationships with identified opinion leaders (private and public sectors)
* Vendor management

**4. SHARED ACCOUNTABILITY**

* Work with CL on country Op Plan; revenue targets, brand A&P and FTE allocations with sales and marketing management.
* With channel marketing – ensure that clear inputs on the customer journey for your brands/ portfolios are shared and development of tactics in conjunction with the channel marketers.
* Long-range demand forecasting with demand planning and manager
* Revenue adjustments, as needed, with sales and business finance manager
* Development of channel strategies with channel marketing and sales
* KOL development – in conjunction with sales and medical
* On-boarding of new PSRs and identifying upskilling requirements with market changes.

**DECISION RIGHTS**

* Sets cluster marketing and launch-excellence frameworks within approved governance.
* Defines launch-readiness standards, review cadence and escalation criteria.
* Recommends priority AI use cases, capability investments and corrective actions.

**CAPABILITIES & QUALIFICATIONS**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Graduate of Pharmaceutical/Medical Sciences, a bachelor’s degree is required, marketing studies or MBA is a plus.
* 3+ years of experience, Commercial/Marketing with consistent successful performance and solid career trajectory.
* Therapeutic Area and market experience are preferred, including Gulf market experience.
* Strong business acumen, analytical skills, customer focus, and the ability to make strategic decisions.
* Strong presentation, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders.
* Marketing qualification/projects/assignments would be an advantage.
* Fluency in English and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* Results-focused and decisive: gets things done through the proper process and manages complexity to make timely, informed decisions.
* Connected collaborator: strong interpersonal, collaboration and negotiation skills, with a track record of influencing others without authority and performing effectively in a matrix organization.
* Courageous and resilient: acts with accountability and integrity without waiting for others, and performs effectively in a complex, changing environment with the maturity to deal with ambiguity.
* Inspiring leader: motivates and develops self and others to drive the business forward.
* Innovative lateral thinker with strategic skills to identify and address major challenges (e.g., new competition, shifting market environment).
* Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, able to analyze, define and convey complex concepts, clear insights and strategies.
* Data analysis, interpretation and communication, with the ability to extract market, customer and competitor insights.
* Well-organized in marketing execution and follow-up: flexible, able to prioritize multiple demands and to develop performance and program metrics.
* Ability to facilitate open discussion and debate among key stakeholders and build internal and external relationships through partnering, anticipating needs and fulfilling expectations
* Exceptional prioritization – among/across brands in portfolio in a resource-constrained context.

**CRITICAL LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS**

Enterprise Mindset

Strategic Challenge

Innovation

Capability Builder

**KEY ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

* Commercial Excellence & AI Lead, Category Leads and market leaders
* Content Excellence, Sales Excellence, Medical, Access, Regulatory, Finance and Compliance
* Regional/global marketing, launch, digital, data and AI teams

**SUPERVISION & OPERATING MODEL**

**Operating model:** Cluster center-of-excellence role enabling category and market teams; role boundaries with Content and Sales Excellence should be formalized in the operating model.

Pfizer Gulf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we are proud of our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive candidate pool to support and empower our workforce.

We strive to ensure that our people are heard, seen and cared for by creating an environment that fosters inclusion and inspires colleagues to speak up to promote an engaging and inclusive culture where they can thrive.

Our diverse workforce represents the patients we serve and the communities in which we operate.

We look forward to reviewing your application and thank you for your interest.

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

jobs.title: Country Brand Lead Lung/Hematology
jobs.description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

**The role partners with category and market leaders** to own portfolio strategy and convert it into robust launch plans, stronger brand choices and scalable, insight-led ways of working.

**Leads the strategy, implementation and execution** of all marketing and promotional activities for the Gulf or Egypt portfolio of brands and therapy areas throughout the product(s) life cycle, ensuring launch success, growth, maximized portfolio value and the realization of revenue and profitability objectives, with the main objective of making the best strategies, tools, materials and communication channels available to all customer-facing colleagues. The CBL leads the cross-functional brand team and coaches Country Brand Managers (CBMs) to deliver the marketing goals across all sectors (private & public) and channels of distribution, in alignment with the company’s goals and strategies.

**CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**1. BRAND STRATEGY & EXECUTION**

* Own portfolio strategy and lead the development of annual brand plans, the Local Brand Plan and the tactical matrix in collaboration with CBMs.
* Develop strategic marketing plans to accelerate launches, uptake and access to new and existing assets, and drive execution of key brand programs.
* Translate market trends, customer and patient insights, competitor activities, and performance data into portfolio priorities, opportunities and risks, including issues, MWMs and CSFs per brand or TA.
* Tailor global and regional strategies to local market needs and define local priorities for each brand.
* Define target customer segments and asset positioning, and lead promotional campaigns and customer engagement activities across all relevant channels and sectors.
* Own brand lifecycle management across the category portfolio, making trade-off decisions on which brands and products to prioritize to maximize growth and maintain competitiveness.
* Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of marketing programs and promotional materials, including adaptation of regional content, and oversee compliance reviews of materials and HCP engagements.

**2. BUSINESS & FINANCIAL PLANNING**

* Deliver sales, revenue, and profitability objectives for the portfolio, and meet or exceed local revenue and A&P objectives.
* Develop the country Op Plan, revenue targets, brand A&P and FTE allocations with the Category Lead.
* Own forecast accuracy: oversee sales forecasting, track brand performance against targets (LE exercises) and provide country input into overall Africa Middle East forecasts.
* Identify risks early and lead mitigation plans and corrective actions to achieve business goals.
* Accountable for planning, spending and controlling of the budgets agreed for the TA of responsibility, ensuring effective allocation of marketing resources across brands.
* Set ROI measures for marketing activities and optimize investment across the portfolio.
* Review pricing and recommend strategic pricing to leverage opportunities in all sectors, working closely with the Access lead.

**3. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Lead the cross-functional brand team across Sales/Field Force, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Legal, Health and Value, Supply Chain, BAI, PHE, Compliance and other key stakeholders.
* Align teams around portfolio priorities, business objectives, and execution plans, and partner with the Category Lead to ensure alignment with overall brand strategy and incorporation of market feedback.
* Partner with Sales/Field Force leadership to ensure effective implementation of campaigns and customer engagement activities, and train the Field Force on product positioning and prioritization.
* Secure product availability through collaboration with Supply Chain and demand planning teams.
* Coordinate with regional and global cross-functional teams to achieve brand objectives, and provide local insights and brand feedback to the Regional Therapeutic Area Lead (RTAL) / Brand Implementation Lead.

**4. EXTERNAL STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and other senior external stakeholders in the private and public sectors, partnering with Medical to educate KOLs on emergent medical research and differentiated product attributes.
* Oversee agencies and vendors, including trans-creation agencies, to ensure high-quality execution of marketing initiatives within agreed budget, scope and timing.
* Identify market opportunities and customer needs, and design value-added customer programs with Medical and Field Force colleagues to ensure strong and consistent Pfizer engagement.

**5. SHARED BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITY**

* Shape country operating plans, forecasting, and long-term business planning with the Category Lead, Sales and Finance.
* Lead channel strategy development and customer journey optimization with channel marketing and Sales.
* Partner with Medical and Sales teams on KOL engagement and capability-building initiatives.
* Coach and develop CBMs, contribute to talent planning and team development, and support onboarding and development of sales team members to ensure strong brand knowledge and execution.

**DECISION RIGHTS**

* Own portfolio prioritization and make trade-off decisions across brands, therapy areas, investments, and initiatives to maximize portfolio performance and business impact.
* Set local brand strategies, customer segmentation, positioning, and tactical priorities by tailoring global and regional strategies to country market needs, and direct the Local Brand Plan and tactical matrix developed with CBMs.
* Approve allocation of marketing resources and A&P investments across the portfolio within agreed budgets to support revenue, launch, and growth objectives, and recommend strategic pricing actions in alignment with the Access lead.

**CAPABILITIES & QUALIFICATIONS**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Pharmacy, Medicine, Pharmaceutical/Medical Sciences, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* MBA or advanced Marketing qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 6 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including a minimum of 2 years of marketing experience.
* Therapeutic Area and cross-market experience are preferred including Gulf and Egypt market experience.
* Demonstrated success in brand management, portfolio and launch leadership, and cross-functional leadership.
* Strong business acumen, analytical skills, customer focus, and the ability to make strategic decisions.
* Strong presentation, communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in English and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* Pharmaceutical brand and portfolio management and marketing strategy development.
* Market analysis, customer insights generation, and data-driven decision making.
* Business planning, forecasting, budget management, and performance tracking at portfolio level.
* Product launch planning and execution, including new asset launches.
* Stakeholder and matrix team leadership, with the ability to coach and develop others.
* Customer segmentation, positioning, and omnichannel engagement.
* Market access and pricing understanding.
* Project, agency, and vendor management.
* Leadership skills to cascade Pfizer’s culture, attract and develop top talent, and inspire teams to exceed expectations.
* Decisive and accountable, comfortable with risk taking and risk management, with strong problem solving skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

**CRITICAL LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS**

Enterprise Mindset

Strategic Challenge

Innovation

Capability Builder

**KEY ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

* **Internal Relationships:** Category Lead, Country Brand Managers, Sales/Commercial and Field Force, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Legal, Finance, Supply Chain, Health and Value, Compliance, Comm

jobs.title: Regional Brand and Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
##### **Job Purpose**

The Regional Brand and Marketing Manager is accountable for managing the execution of a high-impact brand and marketing strategy that drives customer growth and brand equity in alignment with market priorities. Leveraging the CCMB capabilities, the role demands tactical insight and detailed assessment of market dynamics, consumer insights, and competitive positioning to support the implementation of defined brand, commercial, and operational objectives, that are translated into focused, actionable briefs that enable CCMB specialist teams to create and execute effective campaigns, ensuring a seamless customer journey across paid, earned, shared, and owned channels.

The role ensures executional excellence and adherence to the standard operating procedures, enabling cross-functional teams to execute marketing initiatives with precision and efficiency.

**In this role you will:**

* Implement and adapt the Emirates brand strategy within assigned markets ensuring alignment with the CCMB measurement framework, business goals and and local market dynamics. Adapt regional brand positioning to meet local market needs while maintaining consistency and supporting regional opportunities.
* Leverage commercial data, market research, customer insights and analytics to understand the operating environment, business performance and market dynamics. Use these insights to guide tactical decision-making that supports brand performance and customer engagement across their journey contributing to measurable business impact.
* Act as the primary operational liaison between the regional commercial and country management teams and the CCMB specialist functions within assigned markets. Build collaborative relationships and maintain trusted advisor status through excellent account management and business understanding. Support strategic conversations led by the Manager Regional Brand & Marketing to prioritise long-term initiatives, align on brand objectives, and facilitate smooth campaign execution and cross-departmental collaboration to contribute to regional success.
* Deliver brand and marketing plans across the customer journey, ensuring initiatives align with regional brand positioning and are tailored to local market conditions and consumer behaviours. Ensure campaigns are well-briefed, executed within budget and meet delivery standards.
* Manage market level allocation of the regional marketing budget for assigned markets, tracking performance and monitoring spending to ensure financial efficiency and impact. Provide input on marketing return on investment (ROI) to support resource allocation and alignment with business outcomes.
* Identify and escalate risks that could affect brand and marketing execution, including legal, reputational, and operational concerns. Support the development of mitigation strategies to ensure seamless campaign delivery and protect Emirates' brand integrity.
* Stay up to date with trends across paid, earned, shared and owned channels monitoring emerging platforms and evolving marketing behaviours. Recommend adjustments to ensure the brand remains relevant, competitive, and strongly positioned.
* Support cross-functional teams and work closely with leadership to encourage a collaborative, motivated group of marketing professionals. Encourage a culture of innovation, continuous learning and delivery excellence that enables teams to execute brand strategies effectively and achieve business objectives.

##### **Qualification**

**To be successful in this role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Degree or Honours (12+3 or equivalent) in Marketing or similar.
* 8+ years experience in Marketing & Media Communications, Brand/Product management or similar.
* Experience in leadership, market analysis and communication.
* Proven ability to develop and execute global marketing plans tailored to local markets.
* Demonstrated success in collaborating with cross-functional and cross-regional teams to drive alignment and results.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing performance data and extract insights
* Solid track record of landing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns
* Experience adapting global brand messaging to regional audiences
* Effective leadership capabilities, including mentoring direct reports, and facilitating cross-functional collaboration.

Emirates Group, is an international organisation with employees from over 170 nationalities, we encourage applications from across the globe. Your application journey begins by applying via the Emirates Group Careers website. Please ensure your CV is up to date for our talent acquisition team to review your profile. If you meet the criteria of the role, you will then be invited to complete a HireVue video interview, to share more about your experience and your career aspirations. If you are shortlisted, you will then be invited to interview with our hiring managers. If you are successful, your recruiter will reach out to you with an offer and then our Onboarding team will ensure a smooth transition to your new role at Emirates Group.

##### **Salary & benefits**

Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

jobs.title: Manager Brand and Marketing Programme
jobs.description:
##### **Job Purpose**

Our Corporate Communications, Marketing and Brand team is responsible for conveying the essence of Emirates Group. Our team is pivotal in representing the attitudes, beliefs and goals of our organisation across the globe, both internally and with our customers alike!

The role of the **Brand & Marketing Program Manager** **– Corporate Functions** is to develop, lead and manage a brand strategy for their assigned Corporate Function portfolio to provide a competitive edge in line with Emirates Airline/dnata brands by leveraging the different CCMB and business unit capabilities.

This role include supporing and implementing the direction and incremental wealth creation of the Emirates or dnata brand and sub-brands; demonstrate agility in delivery of the strategy, in line with changing business priorities. Proactively identify brand, commercial or operational business objectives that shape both MarComms activities and CCMB Build roadmap of their portfolio. Co-develop, manage, and implement integrated brand and marketing programmes to deliver on the employer value proposition, brand strategy, customer experience promise, or achieve business objectives in partnership with the CCMB team of Specialists.

**In this role you will:**

* Articulate, shape, and communicate the business unit brand strategy and direction with relevant stakeholders by understanding the overall Emirates/dnata brand strategy, wider operating environment, performance, and dynamics of assigned business units. Work closely with EK Group Market Research, marketing strategic planning, analytics and insights functions to generate the relevant and comprehensive insights on the business unit brand, product and customers positioning in the relevant markets.
* Translate and convert the brand strategy, commercial and/or operational business objectives or challenges to single-minded brand and marketing objectives that the specialist teams can deliver across the entire customer lifecycle, journey and touchpoints. Leverage research, data, analytics, and insights to ensure that briefs are clear and articulate so specialist teams can effectively design, develop, and test the proposed response or solutions. Work with the Marketing Strategic Planning team to ensure the briefs are in line with CCM&B Measurement Framework and achieve the required ROI on CCM&B spend.
* Manage the MarComms Programme covering both Run and Build marketing requirements for the respective business unit. Work closely with the respective specialist teams to incorporate the relevant Build roadmap elements into the BU roadmap. Define, track and report the Run marketing requirements for the respective BU. Communicate roadmap and vision with relevant BU stakeholders to ensure alignment were required on a periodic basis.
* Identify and shape how CCMB can optimise the build, delivery and measurement of planned (short-to-long term) Business Unit changes across customer communication touchpoints. Leverage and understand CCMB research, insights and analytics to influence the development of new initiatives, customer experience and journey in line with brand strategy and objectives.
* Identify MarComms capabilities that can be leveraged by respective business unit and influence the CCMB Build roadmap to support business objectives in close collaboration and coordination with the CCMB specialist teams by staying up-to-date with the latest developments in modern marketing and marketing technology.
* Co-develop and influence the prioritisation of the CCMB build roadmaps with each of the specialist teams based on respective business unit requirements. Balance the needs of customers, stakeholders, CCMB resources, brand and commercial requirements, and the desired maturity levels, while appreciating that each Specialist Team owns their respective Build Roadmap.
* Identify synergies and opportunities between portfolios by collaborating with account management counterparts e.g. cross-selling products, aligning and leveraging data.
* Support specialist teams to address or mitigate any risks or issues that may impact roadmap delivery by coordinating or influencing the relevant stakeholders from the business units. Risks or issues such as data governance and privacy, cybersecurity, technical or data integration challenges, legal issues, organisational requirements etc.
* Develop, consolidate, and manage the annual budget requirements to deliver on Brand and MarComms requirements for assigned business units including the presentation of CCMB requirements for resources and funding from respective BPCs.
* Focus on continuous professional development for the team, utilising internal and external partners, to ensure marketing and marketing technology skills and knowledge of the team are relevant and up-to-date, and develop sufficient knowledge of the business units being supported to ensure appropriate solutions are proposed.

##### **Qualification**

**To be successful in this role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Hold an attested Degree or Honours (12+3 or equivalent) in Marketing or similar.
* 10+ years experience in Marketing & Media Communication or similar.
* Experience working as a marketing communications manager with and international organisation.
* Experience in an Airline / Travel industry is preferable.
* Understanding of customer journey development across digital and non-digital touchpoints from a marketing communications perspective, and ability to translate business requirements into marketing communications solutions.
* Project management certification.
* Understanding of 360\* marketing and ability to manage and deliver marketing communications campaigns.
* Broad understanding of marketing technologies including automation programs, marketing data management, CCMB operational value-chain, and operational model with teams such as IT and EA.
* Collaboratively develop a comprehensive functional requirement brief with specialist teams such as: UX/IBE teams, Customer Strategy and Retention, Media and Performance Marketing, Customer Insight and/or EA, and Marketing Analytics.
* Effective communication skills and ability to answer "why" to the questions from stakeholders by leveraging and mastering data, customer feedback and other metrics.
* Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders and influence decision making.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional team.

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

**We are seeking an experienced and proactive Brand Manager to to work closely with an Australian influencer, to build his career, negotiate deals on his behalf, manage his public image, and handle his day-to-day administrative tasks**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* to oversee his day-to-day business affairs
* to build and expand his reach and presence
* to ⁠negotiate deals and projects on his behalf
* to manage his public image and his name brand
* to handle his day-to-day administrative tasks
* to manage his calendar
* to manage his scripts, videos and content to make sure to only go live once approved
* to collab and liaison with other businesses, other influencers, PR agencies, production companies, publishers, and platforms to help build his brand name and awareness.
* to work closely with in-house team to get the job done in a timely manner.
* to ⁠develop and implement strategies to grow and strengthen digital presence and brand visibility across platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and more.
* to be up to date with the latest market trends
* to be creative in the development of brand identity including but not limited to, merchandise, digital and print products, etc.
* to liaison and manage in selecting his best events and awards
* to shoot his videos and edit them.

**Required Skills:**

* Existing industry network and contacts
* Experience in this line of work
* Experience in managing mood swings
* Good communication skills
* Experience in ⁠Social media skills, digital trends and audience engagement
* Experienced in liaison and brand building.

**Technical Knowledge Required:**

* Expert on social media platforms – Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube
* Expert on providing insight reports on social media channels
* Expert on Content Creation (post designs, banner designs and video editing)
* Expert on Video editing for social media
* Expert in MS Office – Word, Excel, Power point etc.
* Excellent eye for details
* Expert and fluent in English language – reading, writing, speaking and listening

**Note:**

* 24x7 availability will be required
* Willingness to travel spontaneously

jobs.title: Senior Global Brand Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
We are looking for a Senior Manager, Brand Marketing - Global to drive the long-term growth of our hero and core franchises, the iconic products at the heart of Huda Beauty. You will own the brand strategy and 360 marketing plans for these franchises, lead cross-functional teams to bring them to life, and partner with global and regional teams to keep our icons relevant, desirable and growing all year round. You will also lead brand defense strategies that protect our hero and core franchises' category leadership against competitive activity.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Own the brand strategy for our hero and core franchises: audience, positioning, messaging and long-term growth plans
* Lead brand defense strategies to protect hero and core franchise category leadership against competitive activity, covering pricing, claims and retail presence
* Build and deliver the annual marketing calendar for the franchise portfolio, from major campaign moments to always-on seasonal and cultural moments
* Lead cross-functional teams (Creative, Communications, Influencer, Paid Media, E-commerce, Retail and Product Development) to deliver 360 campaigns on time and within budget
* Brief and steer Creative to deliver best-in-class, inclusive storytelling and assets
* Drive conversion across every touchpoint, from product pages and claims to in-store presence and media
* Partner with regional teams to translate global strategy into local activation, ensuring consistency across markets
* Track performance, analyze consumer and market trends, and turn insights into action
* Present strategies and results to senior leadership

**Requirements**

* Proven track record leading 360 campaigns across multiple markets
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority
* Commercially minded, with confidence using data to inform strategy and decision-making
* Track record of presenting strategies and results to senior leadership, backed by sharp creative judgment
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* A passion for beauty and makeup artistry is a must
* 10+ years in brand marketing, with strong experience growing hero or core product franchises; prestige beauty strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

**About Us:**

Maritime Mercantile International (MMI) is a leading distributor and retailer of premium wines, spirits, champagne, beer, and non- alcoholic beverages. Headquartered in Dubai, we operate across three continents with a vision to delight every customer through our passion for quality and service. From award-winning concepts like Le Clos Fine Wines & Luxury Spirits to innovative e-commerce platforms and loyalty programs such as MMI Cheers Club, we’re passionate about delivering exceptional experiences at every touchpoint.

As proud subsidiaries of the Emirates Group, MMI & ELR share one mission: to bring more to life. Guided by our HERO values: Honesty, Excellence, Respect, and Opportunity, we create memorable moments for our customers, our people, and the communities we serve.

* Maintain relationships with wineries and suppliers, supporting wine selections and addressing product-related concerns.

**Required Experience, Skills & Qualification:**

* WSET Level 2 as a minimum, with WSET Level 3 (or enrolled with a clear plan to complete it) a strong advantage

* Around 4–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in wine or beverage, or in brand management, marketing, commercial operations, supply chain or project management; strong transferable skills also considered

* Experience managing programmes, allocations, forecasting and stock or supply chain activity, with strong attention to detail

* Experience analysing data and customer feedback and presenting clear recommendations to senior stakeholders

* Strong written communication (including tasting notes) and proficiency in Excel and reporting tools

**Desirable Skills:**

* WSET Level 3 or above, or wine portfolio/fine wine experience

* Experience working with suppliers or wineries, and airline or travel retail experience

* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, with sound judgement, adaptability and autonomy

* Collaborative mindset with a strong sense of responsibility and ability to anticipate challenges

Join a team of experienced professionals who are experts in the industry. We want to create memories and provide an exceptional experience to every customer on every visit. That's why we're passionate about offering a wide variety of delicious and high-quality products. We’re committed to sustainable practices, reducing our environmental impact, and giving back to the communities that we operate in. We're committed to putting our people first by creating a positive and supportive work environment where everyone feels valued and respected

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced SME Card Product Management Specialist to support the launch and ongoing development of an SME cards proposition integrated with a business wallet. The role works across product, digital, operations, technology, sales, marketing and other stakeholders to translate the approved proposition into a coordinated and executable launch plan, drive cross-functional readiness, and support early portfolio growth and performance management.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in cards product and portfolio management, SME card launches, customer lifecycle management and card economics within the Saudi Arabian market.

This is a hands-on role combining product management with strong execution capability, covering launch management, customer journeys, operational readiness, go-to-market and portfolio analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Product & Launch Management

* Support operationalization and launch of the SME card proposition, translating the approved CVP into clear product, business and operational requirements.
* Develop and manage the integrated launch plan, including milestones, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues and accountable owners.
* Coordinate product readiness across features, benefits, eligibility, pricing and fees, customer communications and required approvals.
* Drive cross-functional launch readiness and support final readiness assessments before go-live.

2. Customer Journey & Business Wallet Integration

* Coordinate integration of the SME card proposition with the business wallet across onboarding, application, issuance, activation, usage and servicing.
* Review end-to-end digital and non-digital customer journeys and identify gaps affecting customer experience or launch readiness.
* Work with technology teams, processors and other partners to coordinate business requirements and dependencies.

3. Operational Readiness & Governance

* Support development and refinement of business processes, operating procedures, functional handoffs, controls and escalation mechanisms.
* Establish structured governance covering actions, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions.
* Coordinate stakeholders across product, operations, risk, compliance, technology, finance, marketing, sales and customer service.
* Provide concise management reporting and escalate material launch blockers and dependencies.

4. Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement

* Support development and execution of the SME cards go-to-market plan across relevant customer segments and acquisition channels.
* Coordinate channel readiness across digital, sales, branch and relationship-management channels.
* Support sales teams through product materials, proposition talking points, FAQs, training and stakeholder briefings.
* Support identification and activation of relevant partnership and commercial opportunities.

5. Portfolio Analytics & Commercial Performance

* Develop and maintain SME card portfolio dashboards covering acquisition, activation, utilization, spend and customer segmentation.
* Monitor portfolio KPIs and customer spending behavior to identify growth and optimization opportunities.
* Analyze portfolio economics, including interchange, FX, fees and relevant costs, to identify opportunities to improve commercial performance.
* Conduct market and competitor analysis and recommend initiatives to strengthen portfolio performance.
* Provide management with regular performance reporting, forecasts, insights and actionable recommendations.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 12+ years of experience in cards, payments, product management or portfolio management, preferably with meaningful exposure to SME/commercial cards.
* Proven experience in SME card product launches, CVP development and customer lifecycle management.
* Knowledge of SAMA regulations.
* Knowledge of SME cards (debit, credit and prepaid) profitability and key metrics.
* Experience in campaign execution, customer segmentation and performance analytics.
* Strong understanding of the card lifecycle, including acquisition, onboarding, issuance, activation, transaction usage, servicing and portfolio management.
* Experience launching or managing credit, debit, prepaid or commercial card products and working with card management systems/processors.
* Strong understanding of SME customer needs, business banking propositions, digital/business wallets and card economics.
* Strong knowledge of portfolio analytics and card P&L drivers, including spend, activation, utilization, interchange, FX, fees and acquisition economics.
* Experience coordinating across product, technology, operations, risk, compliance, marketing and sales teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex cross-functional programs, senior stakeholders, launch dependencies and multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and executive communication skills.
* Ability to work onsite in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within a bank, fintech, card issuer, payment network or card processor.

Key Success Outcomes

* Translate the approved SME card proposition into an executable launch plan and achieve launch readiness on schedule.
* Ensure successful integration of the SME card proposition with the business wallet across the full customer journey.
* Establish effective governance, reporting and escalation across all launch workstreams.
* Drive sales and channel readiness, supporting early customer acquisition and adoption.
* Deliver early portfolio growth and performance through clear dashboards, insights and optimization recommendations.

**What we offer:**

* Competitive Salary and Benefits
* Opportunity to be part of a fast-paced and growing startup. Grow your career with the company.
* Ownership – You will own your initiative and be given specific responsibilities.
* Continuous coaching & mentoring – You will have the opportunity to interact and work closely with other senior data scientists and AI experts across the globe.
* Dynamic and respectful work environment – we truly value you.

**Job Requisition ID:** 182830

About Al-Futtaim
  
Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

  
  
**Overview Of The Role:**  
  
  

* As a Brand Manager for Jewelry & Accessories, your role is to lead the commercial, operational, and customer performance of the business. You will drive sustainable sales and profit growth while maintaining brand equity and ensuring exceptional customer experience across all channels. With full accountability for trading performance, merchandising, marketing execution, store operations, and inventory management, you will also focus on people development. Collaboration with various teams, including Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and Retail Operations, is essential to achieve business objectives and support regional growth opportunities.

  
**What You Will Do:**  
  
  

#### **General**

  
  

* Lead the commercial, operational, and customer performance of the Jewelry & Accessories business to achieve sustainable sales and profit growth.
* End-to-end accountability for trading performance, merchandising, marketing execution, store operations, inventory management, and team development.
* Partner with Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and Retail Operations teams to deliver business objectives and support growth opportunities.
* Develop and execute commercial strategies to achieve revenue, margin, and profitability objectives across all channels.
* Optimize assortment, stock levels, and inventory productivity by collaborating with planning and buying teams.
* Work closely with brand principals to define seasonal collections and assortments, maximizing inventory productivity within Open-to-Buy budgets.
* Collaborate with marketing teams to implement campaigns, launches, and activations that increase traffic and brand awareness.
* Implement the visual strategy of the brands across stores to ensure consistent brand presentation and an engaging customer experience.
* Identify opportunities for expansion, category growth, and omnichannel development to support long-term business performance.
  

  
  
**Required Skills To Be Successful:**  
  
  

* Advanced skills in commercial and financial analysis, including budgeting and forecasting.
* Expertise in retail operations management and inventory and merchandise management.
* Strong capabilities in customer experience management and strategic growth initiatives.
* Collaborative leadership with a focus on results orientation, strategic thinking, and adaptability.

  
**What Qualifies You For The Role:**  
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Fashion Merchandising, Marketing or related discipline.
* 5-8 years' experience within retail, fashion, jewelry, accessories or lifestyle brands; commercialization and P&L management.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in merchandising, inventory planning, and retail operations management.
* Experience managing multiple stores and cross-functional teams; proven ability to deliver sales and profit growth in fast-paced environments.

Brand Manager, Oncology, Gulf

➢ ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company

focused on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines

for some of the world’s most serious diseases.

Our ambition in Oncology is to redefine cancer care by following the science and putting

patients at the heart of everything we do. We aim to transform outcomes by bringing innovative

medicines to patients and working across the healthcare ecosystem to address barriers across the

cancer patient journey.

➢ ROLE SUMMARY

The Brand Manager, Oncology, Gulf is responsible for developing and executing brand strategy for assigned Oncology brands and indications across Gulf markets.

Working closely with the Oncology Franchise Lead, the Brand Manager will translate global and regional strategies into locally relevant plans that address market dynamics, customer needs

and opportunities across the patient journey.

The role will lead the brand-planning process, develop positioning and key strategic priorities, support launch and indication-expansion readiness, and drive high-quality execution across appropriate channels.

A critical part of the role is building a deep understanding of the Oncology ecosystem, including evolving treatment pathways, patient identification, diagnosis and testing, treatment initiation, referral patterns and barriers to optimal patient care. The Brand Manager will work cross functionally to identify opportunities where AstraZeneca can improve the customer and patient

experience while delivering sustainable brand growth.

The role requires close collaboration across Sales, Medical, Market Access, Diagnostics, Regulatory and other relevant cross-functional teams, while ensuring full compliance with AstraZeneca policies and local requirements.

➢ WHAT YOU’LL DO

o Brand strategy and business performance

* Lead the development and implementation of the strategic and operational brand plan for

assigned Oncology brand(s) and indications.

* Translate global and regional brand strategy into clear Gulf-market priorities, objectives,

tactics and KPIs.

* Develop robust brand positioning based on the evolving competitive landscape, customer

insights, clinical evidence and patient needs.

* Identify growth opportunities and barriers through analysis of brand performance, market

dynamics, treatment patterns and competitive developments.

* Lead forecasting and brand inputs into the business-planning process, working closely with

relevant commercial and finance stakeholders.

* Establish and monitor meaningful KPIs and brand dashboards, translating insights into

corrective actions when performance moves off plan.

* Manage the brand budget effectively and prioritise investment toward activities with the

greatest strategic impact.

o Launch and indication readiness

* Lead commercial preparation for new product launches and indication expansions, ensuring

clear milestones, accountabilities and readiness across the cross-functional team.

field readiness, market-shaping activities and the appropriate channel mix.

* Anticipate potential barriers to adoption and work cross-functionally to develop appropriate

solutions ahead of launch.

o Patient journey and Oncology ecosystem

* Develop a deep understanding of the Oncology patient journey, identifying critical barriers

from disease awareness and diagnosis through testing, referral, treatment initiation and ongoing

patient management.

* Incorporate biomarker and diagnostic testing pathways, where relevant to the assigned

portfolio, into brand strategy and execution.

* Use patient, physician, account and market insights to identify opportunities to shorten delays

in diagnosis and treatment and improve eligible patient identification.

* Understand the roles and interdependencies of key stakeholders within the Oncology

ecosystem, including oncologists, pathologists, surgeons, radiologists, pharmacists, nurses,

laboratory stakeholders, payers and other relevant decision-makers.

o Customer engagement and omnichannel excellence

* Build a deep understanding of customer needs, behaviours and preferences and translate those

insights into meaningful customer experiences.

* Develop an effective omnichannel marketing mix, selecting the appropriate combination of

personal and digital channels for specific customer segments.

* Partner with field teams to translate brand strategy into clear, actionable customer engagement

priorities.

* Support promotional and scientific events from strategic concept through content development

and execution.

* Manage agencies effectively in developing high-quality campaigns, customer-facing materials,

digital initiatives and field-force promotional resources.

o External stakeholder engagement

* Contribute to the development and execution of stakeholder and Key External Expert (KEE)

engagement plans in partnership with Medical and other relevant functions.

* Build and maintain high-quality relationships with relevant external stakeholders in compliance

with local regulations and AstraZeneca policies.

* Generate actionable insights from customers and the wider Oncology ecosystem and ensure

these insights inform brand strategy and execution.

o Cross-functional leadership

* Act as a key member of the Oncology cross-functional team, creating alignment around the

brand strategy, priorities and execution plan.

* Collaborate effectively with Medical, Market Access, Sales, Diagnostics, Regulatory,

Finance and other functions to deliver integrated brand objectives.

* Demonstrate leadership through influence, bringing stakeholders together around clear

priorities even where there is no direct reporting relationship.

* Identify and share marketing best practices across Gulf markets and the wider AstraZeneca

organisation.

o Compliance and governance

* Demonstrate consistently high standards of business ethics and integrity.

* Ensure all activities comply with the AstraZeneca Code of Conduct, supporting policies and

standards, local laws, industry requirements and applicable promotional procedures.

* Ensure promotional activities and materials are scientifically appropriate, compliant and

executed to the required quality standards.

➢ ESSENTIAL FOR THE ROLE

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g. Pharmaceuticals or science)

* For Internal Candidates: Minimum 5 years of Experience in pharmaceutical industry, with at least one year in AstraZeneca.

* For External Candidates: Minimum 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry out of which minimum 1 year in marketing roles in in Gulf.

* Previous experience in pharmaceutical brand management, marketing or a closely related commercial role.

* Strong understanding of specialty-care markets and complex customer/patient journeys.

* Demonstrated ability to develop strategy and translate it into high-quality tactical execution.

* Strong analytical capability, including experience with forecasting, performance tracking,

customer/market insights and competitive analysis.

* Strong communication, presentation, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.

* Demonstrated ability to lead effectively within a cross-functional matrix organisation.

* Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

* High learning agility and resilience in a rapidly changing environment.

* Ability and willingness to travel within Gulf markets as required.

➢ DESIRABLE FOR THE ROLE

* Previous Oncology marketing experience.

* Experience managing an Oncology brand through launch or indication expansion.

* Understanding of Oncology treatment pathways and the role of biomarkers, diagnostics and precisio

**About us**

NMK Electronics, a Midwich Group company, stands at the forefront of the professional AV industry in the Middle East.  With a strong presence across the region, NMK combines a premium portfolio of reputable brands, a dedicated and skilled team and a reputation built on trust and results that started in the 1980s.  
  
Our expertise has earned us the confidence of top consultants, system integrators and end users. NMK has delivered a number of prominent local AV projects throughout the region, and with a mission to drive growth, this is an exciting time to join the team.
  
  
**About the Role**
The Product Manager will be responsible for managing our Unified Communications (UC) product portfolio and vendors.  You will be the first point of contact for the vendor and have joint success plans while reporting to the business unit manager. You will take ownership of the assigned brands, including business development, pipeline management, vendor engagement, and achievement of agreed targets.
  
The ideal candidate should be an experienced professional, with a proven background in AV and UC products.  You will have a strong background in vendor management, stock and sales engagement.  Forecasting and performance tracking is essential for this role. 
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand your vendor objectives and drivers to feed into relevant sales and marketing activity
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors and their sales teams and communicate with them regularly
* Ensure customer data is accurately maintained and regularly updated within the CRM/ERP systems
* Collaborate with the marketing team to build and showcase a robust client reference portfolio
* Plan monthly stock orders based on sales forecasts
* Track inventory levels, manage aging stock, and free up inactive stock.
* Negotiate pricing, secure projects, and ensure price protection where needed
* Coordinate closely with technical support and application teams to ensure effective client service and timely resolution of technical queries
* Enable the Sales and Technical teams with the required UC product knowledge and support, and work closely with them to identify, develop, and drive opportunities
* Prepare and present a comprehensive quarterly business plan outlining sales targets, key accounts, and strategic initiatives for the upcoming fiscal year
* Support the line manager in identifying and onboarding new sales partners and representatives across the Middle East
* Maintain strong market engagement across key accounts, inside-sales accounts, system integrators, and channel partners, and build and maintain a strong network within the UC channel
* Conduct commercial negotiations to secure orders under favorable financial and contractual terms
* Actively participate in sales initiatives, including client visits, calls, trade exhibitions, product demonstrations, and customer seminars.
* Plan and execute UC partner enablement sessions, product trainings, webinars, customer events, and demand-generation activities.
* Maintain knowledge of all product and service offerings of the company
* Maintain an awareness of market trends and competitor activity

**Job Requirements**

* A minimum of 4–5 years of proven experience in business development within the AV industry, including experience with UC products
* Strong technical competency in UC products, supported by certifications on major UC platforms such as Microsoft Teams.
* Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.
* Strong sales acumen with a demonstrated history of achieving or exceeding targets
* Outstanding communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills
* Strong presentation skills, with confidence in delivering tailored solutions to diverse audiences
* Highly focused and self-motivated
* Exceptional verbal and written English communication
* A valid local driving license is required for this role

Brand Manager, NOW (Leading Nutraceutical Brand)
jobs.description:
The
**Brand Manager, NOW (**
www.nowfoods.com) is responsible for the end-to-end management of assigned nutraceutical brand across GCC markets, covering strategy development, commercial performance, and operational execution. The role is accountable for delivering revenue growth, profitability, and market share, while ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, internal governance standards, and brand guidelines.

The position requires a structured and analytical approach to translating market insights into actionable plans and ensuring consistent execution across multiple channels, including healthcare, e-commerce, modern trade, and tender business. The Brand Manager works closely with Sales, Marketing, Medical, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Finance, and Digital teams to align priorities, optimise performance, and address operational challenges.

In addition, the role contributes to portfolio development and long-term brand sustainability by identifying growth opportunities, supporting new product initiatives, and strengthening customer and stakeholder engagement. The Brand Manager is expected to operate with a high level of accountability, collaboration, and integrity, in line with NCH Culture, ensuring both business performance and organisational alignment.

**What You Will Own**

Brand Strategy, Business Planning & P&L

* Own the short and long-term strategy for NOW across the GCC, translating market opportunities into clear commercial priorities and growth plans.
* Lead the annual business planning process, setting objectives for revenue, profitability, market share, distribution, portfolio development and brand investment.
* Take direct accountability for the brand P&L, including revenue, gross margin, marketing investment, trade spend and overall profitability.
* Manage the trade-offs between sales growth, margin, investment, pricing, inventory and long-term brand development.
* Lead regular business reviews, identify performance gaps and determine corrective actions to ensure commercial commitments are delivered.

Distribution & Channel Development

* Define and implement distribution strategy, ensuring optimal presence across key accounts, channels, and customer segments.
* Expand distribution in high-potential accounts while rationalising underperforming channels to improve efficiency and return on investment.
* Monitor channel contribution and account performance, reducing over-reliance on single customers or channels.
* Contribute to tender and institutional business planning, supporting pricing, participation decisions, and volume planning in coordination with commercial and regulatory teams.
* Align with Sales teams to ensure execution of distribution priorities and commercial plans.

Marketing Strategy & Budget Governance

* Develop and manage the annual brand marketing and trade budget across offline and online channels, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities and ROI targets.
* Allocate resources across medical, trade, and digital activities based on performance data, customer insights, and channel roles.
* Ensure full compliance with brand guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal financial controls.
* Monitor budget utilisation, manage accruals and variances, and optimise spend effectiveness in coordination with Finance.
* Partner with principals to translate global strategies into locally relevant, compliant, and commercially effective marketing plans.

Brand Activation & Omnichannel Execution

* Translate brand strategy into integrated marketing plans covering medical promotion, trade activities, and digital campaigns.
* Ensure consistent execution of brand messaging, positioning, and visual identity across all channels and customer touchpoints.
* Drive campaign effectiveness by continuously evaluating performance and optimising promotional activities.
* Leverage digital platforms and data analytics to enhance customer engagement, improve campaign effectiveness, and support omnichannel growth.

Forecasting, Supply & Inventory Management

* Lead brand-level forecasting and demand planning, ensuring alignment with sales trends, promotional plans, and market dynamics.
* Work closely with Supply Chain to ensure product availability, minimise stock-outs, and maintain optimal service levels.
* Monitor inventory health, proactively managing slow-moving and near-expiry stock through corrective actions.
* Support lifecycle planning including launches, relaunches, and phase-outs in coordination with relevant functions.
* Identify portfolio gaps and contribute to new product initiatives, line extensions, and portfolio optimisation based on market needs and performance insights.

Field Excellence & Customer Engagement

* Define medical detailing priorities, target segments, and core messages aligned with brand strategy and scientific positioning.
* Develop and refine customer segmentation and targeting strategies to optimise field force effectiveness and resource allocation.
* Ensure field teams are equipped with compliant, up-to-date materials and clear execution objectives.
* Conduct selective field visits to assess execution quality, provide coaching, and ensure alignment with brand standards.
* Leverage CRM insights to refine targeting, improve engagement, and enhance customer experience.

Team Contribution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Contribute to building a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team environment in line with NCH Culture DNA.
* Support team development through coaching, feedback, and alignment on objectives and priorities.
* Drive effective cross-functional collaboration to ensure alignment, speed, and execution excellence.
* Promote a culture of ownership, integrity, and continuous improvement across all interactions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders to support brand growth and execution excellence.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Nutrition, or a related field, with an MBA.
* 8+ years of experience in brand management and business development in the wellness/healthcare industry and across channels, including pharmacies, tender and e-commerce channels.
* Strong experience managing teams within nutraceuticals, dietary supplements, consumer healthcare or another relevant consumer-led sector.
* Proven responsibility for a significant brand, category, portfolio or business unit and hands-on experience managing P&L, revenue, gross margin, pricing, budgets and profitability.
* Experience managing international brand principals, manufacturers or regional partners is strongly preferred.
* Strong critical thinking, commercial negotiation, stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.

We are looking for a passionate Brand Manager to become part of our Regional Brand team located in the Dubai talabat office. * Connect brand investment to commercial outcomes; co-develop the brand-to-performance consumer journey with cross-functional teams, ensuring upper-funnel brand work is measurably linked to conversion.

* Prioritise for strategic impact; maintain a clear model for evaluating incoming work, ensuring the team's energy is directed toward the initiatives that move the brand forward most.
* Maintain visibility across market-level brand activity; build a lightweight system for monitoring our brand across markets, enabling shared learnings and coordinated planning across the region.

* You have experience with a number of categories and industries

* You use AI as a daily force multiplier — augmenting your thinking rather than replacing it, and elevating the depth and pace of your output

* You are a collaborative team player, with experience with working with teams in a matrix organization, located in the different locations while predominantly communicating virtually
* You are excellent in relationship and stakeholder management
* You are a persuasive and confident communicator - both written and verbal
* You have worked within an agency background (desirable to have)
* You are fluent in English and Arabic

As the Regional Product Marketing Manager for the Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS) readers, you will drive the definition, realization, and ongoing evolution of the portfolio. This includes developing strategy, product roadmaps, market requirements, pricing, product positioning, and launch success.
  
  
**Who are we?**
HID powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely.
  
  
We are a high-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,500 worldwide employees. Check us out here: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
**Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS):**
HID Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS) is at the forefront of securing spaces with advanced, reliable access control solutions. From cutting-edge readers, credentials and controllers, to mobile and biometric technologies, HID PACS empowers organizations worldwide to protect their people, property and assets with scalable, high-quality solutions.
  
  
This is more than just a job – it’s your chance to join an industry leader to drive innovation in access control and make a real impact on global security solutions.
  
  
Are you ready to make a difference? Join us and help shape the future of security.
  
  
**As our**
**Regional Product Marketing Manager**
**, you’ll support HID’s success by:**

* Implementing the product strategy for HID Global’s physical access control solutions (PACS) readers
* Defining market requirements and business opportunity; own the high-level product roadmap and be accountable to its execution
* Acting as the voice of the customer (partner and end user) to product management, cloud services and the rest of the organization
* Collecting, analyzing and reporting on needs and trends based on end user and channel surveys as well competitive and industry analysis to provide input to the reader product roadmap
* Educating the rest of the organization on reader products and be the center of competency for market knowledge, sizing and customer profiles
* Strategizing and defining decision criteria of prospects, channels and end users to position HID readers against competition

* Developing product data suitable for product promotion through various channels

* Leading key relationships within the physical access control market in order to stay abreast of standards, policies and technology adoption
* Reviewing and reporting regularly on segment and geographical business performance including revenue, product mix, and margin trends and advice the organization on improvement implementations to drive both growth and profitability
* Generating and implementing channel strategies with the sales and marketing organization, including pricing and discount strategies

**Your Experience and Background include:**

* Minimum of bachelor’s degree in marketing or other relevant discipline
* Candidates with equivalent education plus relevant work experience may also be considered
* Minimum 5+ years product marketing or product management related positions
* Professional proficiency in English and Arabic, both written and verbal, is required.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders across the region.
* Proven ability to successfully launch products and services on a global basis
* Strong expertise in the area of physical security
* Understanding of access control systems
* Experience operating in a product development team using SAFe for Lean Enterprises methodology
* Proven capability of cross-functional collaboration & ability to gain consensus
* You are decisive but open to new ideas
* You are a self-starter, entrepreneurial
* You are a quick learner
* Data & analysis driven
* You are comfortable with, and able to manage constructively; change, ambiguity, debate, conflict, and informed risk taking
* Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the hiring country.
* Visa sponsorship may be available for qualified candidates, subject to company policy and local immigration requirements.
* Any sponsorship support will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis

**What we can offer you:**

* Competitive salary and rewards package
* Competitive benefits and annual leave offering, allowing for work-life balance
* A vibrant, welcoming & inclusive culture
* Extensive career development opportunities and resources to maximize your potential
* To be a part of a global organization that is pioneering the hardware, software and services that allow people to confidently navigate the physical and digital worlds

**Why apply?**

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted

Our goal is to create a workplace that empowers everyone to thrive and be their authentic selves, fostering an environment of mutual respect and inclusivity.
