jobs.description:
### **Position**

Chaumet is seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and passionate **Senior Product Marketing Manager** to join our Middle East regional office.

Reporting directly to the General Manager - Middle East, this pivotal role is instrumental in driving product lifecycle strategies, go-to-market execution, consumer understanding, and 360° integration across the region.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in bringing deep product and consumer expertise to jointly developed 360° plans, ensuring our collections resonate strongly in the market and contributing to the overall success and desirability of Chaumet in the region.

### **Job responsibilities**

### **Strategic Responsibilities:**

Co-develop the annual plan, product launch strategy, and campaign calendar alongside the Media and PR Managers, establishing common KPIs: Align cross-functional initiatives to ensure cohesive execution and shared accountability across departments.  

Leverage CRM, retail insights, and market intelligence to drive product desirability, manage category performance, and execute a robust Recruit / Retain / Return strategy: Optimize collection lifecycle management and client retention frameworks based on quantitative data.  
Identify local product and content gaps, translating global brand priorities and product roadmaps into locally relevant regional expressions: Ensure global high jewelry and watchmaking collections resonate with regional client preferences and cultural nuances.  
Analyze assortment performance, sell-through rates, and stock distribution across boutiques: Partner with merchandising teams to optimize depth and breadth by door, ensuring top-performing lines are prioritized.  
* Drive competitive intelligence and market benchmarking: Monitor regional competitor product introductions, pricing strategies, and positioning shifts to proactively identify commercial opportunities.
  

### **Operational & Cross-Functional Delivery:**

Own and manage the master calendar, product go-to-market briefs, and cross-functional delivery timelines: Drive flawless execution from initial product allocation to final boutique rollout.  

Lead local creative briefs and production, partnering with the Media Manager to define product asset needs upstream: Translate global product storytelling into localized digital and print assets.  
Coordinate HQ requests, content co-planning, and validation processes, while consolidating results and defining corrective actions: Act as the primary regional liaison for global product marketing teams.  
Partner with CRM, Events, VM, and Retail teams to ensure cohesive planning and execution across all touchpoints: Deliver an immersive 360-degree client experience during new product reveals and high-profile exhibitions.  
* Monitor post-launch performance and compile comprehensive campaign debriefs: Track ROI, media impact, and sales conversion metrics to inform future product strategies and budgeting.

### **Profile**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.  

8-10 years of progressive experience in product marketing, brand marketing, or campaign management, preferably within luxury retail, high jewelry, watchmaking, or a similar luxury environment.  
Deep understanding of product lifecycle management, 360° campaign orchestration, consumer behavior, and content strategy, with a strong grasp of product, consumer, and digital touchpoints.  
Exceptional project management capabilities with meticulous attention to detail and a structured approach to master calendar management.  
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret CRM, retail, and market insights to drive business impact.  
Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across peer groups and regional teams.  
Ability to work independently, prioritize complex tasks, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.  
* Fluency in English and Arabic; French is a strong asset.

***CHAUMET*** 
**MAISON**
-------------------------

In the heart of Place Vendôme in Paris, Chaumet crafts jewelry that melds audacity and elegance. Combining tradition and modernity, the artisans of Chaumet’s High Jewelry workshop pass on their exceptional know-how to create masterpieces of lightness and movement, including the Maison’s famed tiaras. Chaumet’s emblematic collections are inspired by the multi-faceted personality of Empress Joséphine, the Maison’s first prestigious client, who designated Chaumet as her official jeweler. Since the founding of the Maison in 1780, Chaumet’s timeless style has continually evolved with the times and influences of the world for more than 240 years.
  
The first jeweler to set up shop on Place Vendôme in 1812, Chaumet has made this mythic nexus of Parisian jewelry its beating heart. Chaumet celebrated its 240th anniversary in 2020 with the inauguration of its magnificently renovated address at 12, Place Vendôme. Bridging tradition and modernity, *12 Vendôme* embodies the soul of Chaumet through three exceptional spaces: the boutique welcoming clients, the historic grand salons – notably the Salon Chopin – and the High Jewelry workshop, where dreams come alive….

jobs.title: CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager – Middle East & Asia**

**Location:** Dubai

**Reports to:** Head of Growth Marketing Hub & Innovation – Middle East & Asia

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**

The **CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager** maximises the commercial effectiveness of CRM across 30+ schools in the Middle East, India and Asia, improving customer progression and conversion through effective lifecycle journeys, automation, segmentation, personalisation and continuous optimisation.

The role translates Group CRM strategy, lifecycle frameworks and platform capability into a **prioritised divisional CRM and lifecycle Marketing improvement roadmap**, using customer, funnel and market evidence to determine where intervention will have the greatest commercial impact.

Operating within Group-owned CRM strategy, architecture, governance, data standards and common lifecycle frameworks, the role leads the CRM Executive / Specialist and acts as the principal divisional interface with Group CRM / Technology. Admissions, Retention and school teams retain accountability for their respective customer processes and operational outcomes.

**ROLE IN THE OPERATING MODEL / SCOPE**

* **Owns CRM & lifecycle Marketing performance and optimisation across MEA.**
* **Enables rather than replaces business ownership of customer processes.**  
  Admissions, Retention and school teams retain ownership of customer processes and outcomes within their remit, including data capture, lead follow-up and customer intervention. CRM & Lifecycle Marketing improves these processes through journeys, automation, segmentation, communications and insight.
* **Leads a portfolio capability, not a school-by-school service desk.**  
  Leads the CRM Executive / Specialist, who provides configuration, execution, QA and reporting against agreed priorities. CRM resource is prioritised according to customer and commercial impact across the portfolio.
* **Manages divisional CRM demand within enterprise governance.**  
  Manages CRM demand, optimisation and delegated administration through the COE intake and prioritisation process. Routine activity is handled through standard capability, self-service or accountable business owners; requirements affecting enterprise CRM strategy, architecture, core workflows, integrations or standards are partnered with Group CRM / Technology.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **CRM Roadmap & Prioritisation**

Own the CRM improvement roadmap, using customer, funnel and CRM performance evidence to prioritise capability, adoption and optimisation interventions across 30+ schools according to commercial impact and customer need.

* **Portfolio CRM Performance & Journey Optimisation**

Monitor portfolio CRM performance, diagnose material conversion gaps and variation, and determine the appropriate CRM intervention.

Apply and continuously optimise Group-established lifecycle journeys and workflows through configuration, segmentation, messaging, timing, channel and automation within agreed standards.

* **Segmentation, Lead Scoring & Experimentation**

Apply and optimise segmentation and lead-scoring approaches within Group frameworks and lead the divisional CRM experimentation programme, using evidence from tests and conversion performance to improve CRM-controlled journeys and recommend enhancements where common capability should evolve.

* **Market Requirements & Group CRM Partnership**

Act as the interface with Group CRM / Technology, translating legitimate customer, commercial, regulatory and operational requirements into clear business requirements and jointly determining whether the response should be local configuration, controlled variation or enterprise capability change.

* **CRM Performance Insight & Business Enablement**

Translate CRM, journey, adoption and conversion data into clear priorities and recommendations for Regional Marketing Managers, Admissions, Retention and other business owners.Distinguish CRM issues from wider process, follow-up, proposition or Marketing issues so accountability remains with the appropriate owner.

* **CRM Governance, Data Quality & Controlled Administration**

Maintain disciplined CRM governance within delegated Group guardrails, including QA, documentation and change control. Establish scalable guidance and self-service capability, ensuring CRM demand is routed through agreed intake and prioritisation processes and that routine activity remains with the appropriate business owner.

* **New School Onboarding**

Lead CRM and lifecycle Marketing onboarding for new schools, including CRM data migration, configuration, permissions and adoption, working with Group CRM / Technology and relevant specialist owners to ensure continuity and compliance.

* **Team Leadership & Scalable Delivery Model**

Lead and develop the CRM Executive / Specialist, setting priorities, quality standards and clear delegation between Manager-level optimisation and execution. Build self-sufficiency among Regional Marketing Managers, Admissions, Retention and school users through guidance, training and Group-approved resources, routing routine activity to self-service or business ownership where appropriate.

* **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

Identify relevant opportunities in automation, personalisation, AI, channel integration and CRM practice; test improvements within agreed guardrails and feed evidence back to Group so successful divisional learning can inform wider enterprise capability.

**FUNCTIONAL CAPABILITIES REQUIRED**

* **Lifecycle Marketing & Conversion Optimisation**

Strong expertise in applying and improving lifecycle journeys, diagnosing funnel leakage and optimising CRM-controlled progression within enterprise frameworks.

* **Marketing Automation & CRM Platforms**

Strong hands-on capability with HubSpot or comparable enterprise CRM / automation platforms, including workflows, segmentation, forms, email, reporting and controlled administration.

* **Segmentation, Personalisation & Lead Scoring**

Ability to apply and optimise segmentation, scoring and personalisation approaches that improve relevance, prioritisation and conversion.

* **CRM Roadmapping, Governance & Process Improvement**

Ability to translate enterprise CRM strategy into a prioritised divisional roadmap, improve processes within defined decision rights and avoid competing standards or architectures.

* **CRM Analytics, Testing & Performance Insight**

Ability to analyse journey and conversion performance, define useful CRM measures and reporting requirements, and run structured experimentation that produces actionable learning.

* **CRM Data, Integrations & Technical Fluency**

Working understanding of CRM data structures, data quality, website/form capture, messaging tools, BI, APIs and integrations sufficient to define requirements and work effectively with enterprise technical owners.

* **Multi-Channel Lifecycle Communications**

Strong understanding of lifecycle communication across approved channels, including sequencing, frequency, personalisation, deliverability and quality assurance of conversion-focused content and templates.

**LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES REQUIRED**

* **Commercial & Conversion Judgement**

Prioritises CRM activity according to customer value, enrolment progression and measurable business impact rather than engagement metrics alone

* **Systems & Journey Thinking**

Understands the dependencies between customer journeys, technology, data, communications and human follow-up and favours scalable solutions over isolated campaigns.

* **Analytical Problem Solving**

Diagnoses conversion and process issues, tests hypotheses and distinguishes CRM problems from wider Marketing, Admissions, Retention or technology issues.

* **Prioritisation & Stakeholder Influence**

Makes clear trade-offs across competing market requirements and aligns business and Group stakeholders around journey, process and platform improvements.

* **People Lead

**Job Summary**
---------------

**About SC Ventures**

**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**

* **Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.**
* **Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.**
* **Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.**
* **Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).**
* **Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.**

**Business**

* **Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.**
* **Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.**
* **Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.**
* **Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.**
* **Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.**

**Processes**

**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* **Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.**
* **Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels, such as WhatsApp campaigns, outbound email sequences, account-based marketing for high-value accounts, partner referrals and B2B directories.**
* **Build landing pages, lead forms and email and WhatsApp nurture journeys that turn interest into qualified leads.**
* **Set up and manage the core marketing tools (e.g. CRM and marketing automation such as HubSpot) and tracking so every lead can be traced back to its source.**
* **Grow HAL's organic visibility through SEO and content, including in AI-assisted search.**

**Events & Field Marketing**

* **Plan and deliver HAL's events programme: launch events, SME workshops, roundtables, webinars and networking sessions.**
* **Represent HAL at relevant trade shows and industry events across the UAE, making sure every event produces qualified leads with clear follow-up.**
* **Build relationships with chambers of commerce, trade associations, free zones and SME programmes to reach SMEs at scale.**

**Thought Leadership, Content & PR**

* **Build a thought leadership programme that positions HAL and its leaders as trusted voices on SME growth, B2B trade and trade finance in the UAE.**
* **Manage leadership's LinkedIn presence and secure speaking slots, panels and media interviews.**
* **Create content that educates and converts, such as articles, guides, case studies, newsletters, short videos and webinars, in English and Arabic where needed.**
* **Manage PR and media relations for launches and milestones, working with agencies where needed.**

**Brand & Sales Enablement**

* + **Establish HAL's brand positioning, key messages and visual identity, and keep them consistent across all touchpoints.**
  + **Create sales materials, such as pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies, that help the commercial team convert leads.**
  + **Gather customer and market insights (feedback, competitor moves, win/loss reasons) to sharpen messaging and targeting.**

**Risk Management**  
• Continuously evaluate agency roster to ensure that right agencies are onboarded while accommodating within the budget requirements

**Governance**  
• Ensure compliance with all SCB and venture governance frameworks.
  
• Manage the function within budgetary constraints, seeking operational efficiencies

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**  
• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  
• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

jobs.title: Regional Product Manager-GCC(A13522)
jobs.description:
**Role purpose**

The voice of the GCC markets in the product process. You are the link between our product teams in China, regional management and our local distributors. You make sure the cars, versions, features and prices we bring to the GCC fit what customers here want, and that every launch is ready from the first day.

You are not running campaigns. You help decide what we sell, to whom and at what price, and you turn what you learn here into clear recommendations.

**Key responsibilities**

- Portfolio and lifecycle: Help plan the model line-up and the business case for each GCC market, together with the product teams in China and the regional sales team. Give regional input through the life of each model: model-year updates, feature changes, price reviews and how competitive the car stays after launch. Support volume and version-mix planning. The teams that make the final commercial decisions have the final say.

- Customer needs: Turn what GCC customers want into clear product and specification requirements for China.

- Versions and features: Look at trims, equipment and features, find gaps, and recommend the right versions for each market.

- Competitors and pricing: Lead the comparison with competitors in each GCC country: specifications, technology, prices, offers and what they promise customers. Recommend where each car should sit in the market, and at what price and version, backed by evidence.

- Market knowledge: Follow market trends, new competitors, EV adoption, charging networks and what makes customers buy. Review sales, version mix and feedback to find improvements and new opportunities.

- Launch readiness: Lead the product side of readiness for new models, facelifts, model-year updates and new features. Make sure specifications, versions, product information, price recommendations and availability agree across sales, marketing, China and distributors. After launch, review how each product did and use the lessons in the next plan.

- Product material: Write the key selling points, technical briefs, competitor comparisons and training material for regional and local teams.

- Work with marketing: Plan launches together with marketing. You give product direction and check that content is correct. Marketing runs the campaigns.

- Technology and features: Check if features such as intelligent driving, connected car, infotainment, navigation and charging are suitable and ready for our markets. Find out what local customers expect, including language, infrastructure and local conditions, and tell the product teams in China what matters most. Coordinate the local setup of features and make sure customer information is accurate.

- Approvals: Support the homologation work led by our teams in China by passing on local requirements, document requests and distributor feedback.

- Authorities: Work with local authorities when needed, for example Dubai's Roads and Transport Authority (RTA), to clarify requirements and help with approvals and testing of advanced driving technology. Work with our technical, legal and regulatory teams on the rules for driver assistance, automated driving and connected car features. Follow changes in the rules, and warn the team early if they could affect features, specifications or launch dates.

- Distributors: Be the main product contact for distributors and the product teams in China, and bring their requests and priorities together. Train distributors and keep product updates, specification guides and competitor tools up to date.

- Across teams: Work with sales, after-sales, engineering and product teams to answer product questions and raise problems that keep coming back. Set up a simple way to collect feedback, and help local teams keep the message to customers consistent across the GCC.

**What this role does not do**

- Lead vehicle approvals. Our teams in China lead homologation. Technical certification stays with them and our local partners.

- Make the final commercial decisions on price and volume. You recommend. The teams responsible decide.

- Run marketing campaigns. Marketing runs them.

**Requirements**

- Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, engineering, automotive technology or a related field.

- 6 or more years in automotive product management, product planning, or similar work at a car maker or distributor.

- Strong knowledge of GCC car customers, how the market works, distributors and competitors.

- Proven experience with vehicle specifications, trims, pricing and competitor comparison, and with new model launches.

- Strong business and analysis skills: you can read sales, version mix, pricing and market data.

- Working knowledge of car regulations, and able to work with technical teams in China and with local authorities.

- Excellent English, strong presentation skills, and able to work with people in China and across the GCC.

**Nice to have**

- Experience with EVs, intelligent mobility, connected cars or driver assistance technology.

- Experience in a regional office of a car maker, or with an international distributor network.

- Experience working with government or regulators on vehicle technology, such as the RTA or similar GCC authorities.

- Experience working with product or engineering teams in China.

- Arabic.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Edenred**
Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.
  
  
Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.
  
  
Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.
  
  
True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.
  
  
Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
  
  
In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.
  
  
Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.
  
  
**The UAE CONTEXT**
Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.
  
  
We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).
  
  
**THE ROLE**
Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.
  
  
You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.
  
  
Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.
  
  
The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.
* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.
* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.
* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.
* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.
* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.
* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.
* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.
* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.
* Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.
* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.
* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.
* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.
* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.
* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.
* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:
  
  

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.
* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.
* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.
* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.
* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.
  
  
**REPORTING STRUCTURE**
Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.
  
  
Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance, Financial Crime, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and product managers across the business.
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE**
You will not be the eleventh PM on a mature product in a crowded market. You will own high-visibility initiatives end-to-end, from problem definition to measurable business outcome, on a platform that has a direct, visible effect on the financial lives of millions of people.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of problem, apply.
  
  
*Edenred UAE is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or background.*

jobs.title: Product Manager - Travel
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

**As Product Manager - Travel**
, you will own travel products across WeStay's luxury supply and distribution stack, working alongside the technology team in DIFC. You will turn commercial opportunity into clear, buildable product, launch it, commercialize it, and prove its success with data. A defining part of this role is expanding what WeStay can sell. Alongside hotels, you will help bring luxury offline and on request inventory, such as private jets, yachts and luxury trains, into our business mix, together with the ancillary products that complete the traveler's journey, such as airport transfers and meet and greet. Online bookable and request led products will sit together in one coherent offering. This is a hands on role for someone who has a strong grasp of how availability, rates, inventory and content actually flow, and who wants to use AI to move faster than the industry around them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Product ownership and commercialization**

• Own the roadmap, backlog and release priorities for assigned travel products, tied to revenue, margin and adoption outcomes.

• Take products from idea to launch and then to commercial scale, regularly creating and driving the project plans and go to market plans, with clear pricing inputs and success measures.

• Translate business needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and specifications that engineers can build against.

**Hotel, luxury and offline inventory**

• Own hotel supply and distribution capability across content, rates, availability and inventory, including supplier connectivity and booking flows.

• Bring luxury offline and on request inventory, including private jets, yachts and luxury trains, into WeStay's mix, covering both online and offline models.

• Build out the ancillary products that complete the user's journey, such as airport transfers, meet and greet and other services around the trip, so that luxury is delivered end to end.

• Define how availability, rates, inventory and content are captured, maintained and presented for inventory that has no live connection, including request, quote and confirmation workflows.

• Work with operations and sales so that offline products are managed with the same discipline and visibility as online ones.

**AI first innovation**

• Use AI tools to prototype, test and validate ideas quickly before committing engineering effort.

• Identify and deliver AI and agentic use cases across search, booking, servicing and operations.

• Look for ways to disrupt a mature travel technology landscape, rather than simply replicate it.

**Metrics, insight and adoption**

• Define product KPIs and use data and analytics to measure product success, customer behavior and usage.

• Turn insight into action: improve conversion, drive adoption and retire what is not working.

• Report progress, risks and opportunities clearly to senior leadership.

**Collaboration and delivery**

• Work closely with engineering on architecture, integrations and scalability, and challenge designs where needed.

• Partner with operations, marketing, finance, sales and supplier teams so that releases land well across the business.

• Work directly within the Scrum process alongside the engineering team, taking part in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related technical field.

• Minimum 7 years in product management, with proven success launching and commercializing software products.

• Travel industry domain expertise, with a working understanding of availability, rates, inventory and content, and how each is managed.

• Solid technical grounding in APIs, integrations, data models and cloud platforms, enough to challenge designs and guide engineers. Deep coding is not expected.

• Demonstrated use of metrics and data analytics to measure product performance, understand customer behaviour and drive adoption.

• Agile delivery experience (Scrum or Kanban) using tools such as Jira and Confluence.

• Strong written and verbal communication, with proven ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders.

**HIGHLY DESIRABLE**

• MBA or equivalent postgraduate business qualification.

• Demonstrable AI skills: shipped or prototyped AI features, agentic tools or LLM based workflows, and daily, fluent use of AI tools in product work.

• Exposure to hotel systems and distribution, such as bed banks, channel managers, CRS, PMS, GDS or XML connectivity.

• Exposure to the luxury segment, including private aviation, yachting, luxury rail, high end experiences and ancillary services such as airport transfers and meet and greet.

• Ecommerce product experience.

• Airline industry experience is a plus.

jobs.description:
Welcome to
**MultiBank Group**
, a global financial pioneer established in 2005 in California and now proudly headquartered in Dubai, UAE. We specialize in delivering cutting-edge trading technology, unparalleled liquidity, and exceptional customer service. Our extensive range of financial products includes Forex, Metals, Shares, Indices, Commodities, and Cryptocurrency CFDs.

Join our thriving community of over 2 million clients across 100 countries, contributing to a daily trading volume exceeding US$ 35 billion. As a heavily regulated institution with oversight from 18+ financial regulators across 5 continents, and recipient of over 80 financial awards, MultiBank Group is devoted to innovation, excellence, and empowering our clients to achieve their financial goals.

As we continue to expand globally, MultiBank Group is seeking a
**Marketing Manager**
to join
**MultiBank Exchange,**
our leading institutional Electronic Communication Network (ECN) providing deep liquidity, competitive pricing, and advanced execution solutions to financial institutions, brokers, hedge funds, proprietary trading firms, asset managers, and other professional market participants. Our technology-driven platform delivers transparent access to global FX liquidity while enabling clients to optimize execution quality and trading performance.

**Role Overview**

You will own MultiBank Exchange’s global marketing: brand, content, digital, events and sales enablement, with the aim of growing the Exchange’s global market penetration among institutional clients. This is a hands-on role for someone who already knows the institutional FX and electronic trading world and can explain it credibly to a trader, a head of FX or a prime-of-prime desk.

You will work day to day with the commercial, product, technology and liquidity teams, and with senior leadership. You will also draw on MultiBank Group’s existing web, video, events and design teams, so this role is about directing and coordinating shared resources as much as producing work yourself.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and brand**

* Build and run MultiBank Exchange’s global marketing plan, tied to commercial targets and reviewed quarterly.
* Sharpen the Exchange’s positioning against other institutional liquidity venues, and keep messaging consistent across every channel.
* Build regional market-entry and expansion plans, and identify new segments, regions and partnerships that raise visibility and grow global market penetration.

**Content and product marketing**

* Produce product collateral, thought leadership, case studies, videos, email and social content that explain the Exchange’s liquidity and execution features in terms clients care about.
* Keep all materials accurate and current, working with product, technology and liquidity teams.

**Digital and market growth**

* Own the Exchange website, including content, conversion and performance.
* Plan and run multi-channel campaigns (LinkedIn, email, paid, trade media) and report on reach, engagement and penetration by region and client segment.
* Use analytics to decide what to stop, change and scale.

**Events, PR and communications**

* Work with MultiBank Group’s events team to run the Exchange’s presence at industry conferences, exhibitions, webinars and client events, and measure the return on each.
* Manage PR agencies and trade media relationships; write press releases, announcements and executive profiles.
* Build relationships with industry bodies, partners and key stakeholders.

**Sales enablement**

* Work with the institutional sales team on account-based campaigns and client acquisition plans.
* Create pitch decks, one-pagers, brochures and other sales tools, and support product launches.

**Governance and collaboration**

* Ensure all external content goes through compliance review and meets financial promotion rules in each market we target.
* Manage designers, agencies and vendors, and the marketing budget.
* Work with MultiBank Group’s existing teams for web, video, events, design and PR, and agree priorities, turnaround times and ownership with each so Exchange work is delivered on time and on brand.
* Make sure the Exchange’s institutional positioning is protected when shared Group teams and assets are used, and adapt Group content that is aimed at retail audiences.
* Track competitors, industry developments and market trends, and share what you learn with leadership and sales.

**Requirements**

**Essential**

* 5+ years of B2B marketing in institutional FX, liquidity providers, electronic trading, capital markets or fintech.
* A track record of delivering integrated marketing plans that produced measurable market growth, not only activity.
* Working knowledge of institutional FX market structure: liquidity, execution quality, prime brokerage and the main client types.
* Strong writing and the ability to turn technical concepts into clear client-facing messaging.
* Hands-on experience with website management, a marketing automation or CRM platform, and campaign analytics.
* Experience running events and working with PR agencies.
* Sound project and stakeholder management, and a comfortable working relationship with compliance in a regulated environment.

**Desirable**

* Previous experience at an institutional trading venue, a liquidity provider, a prime broker or an institutional trading technology vendor.
* An existing network among institutional FX participants.
* Account-based marketing experience.
* Experience marketing across multiple regions, such as MENA, Europe and APAC.
* Additional languages.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work within a high-growth, industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.
* Fast-paced environment with significant ownership and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborative, diverse, and high-performance engineering culture.
* Opportunity to contribute to mission-critical trading applications used worldwide

*Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance*

It provides advanced in-studio cameras, broadcasting on-air, online on smartphone apps and the Apple TV platform. ARN has ten radio stations, including Dubai Eye, Virgin Radio, Al Arabiya and Hit - reaching over 200 nationalities and 4 million listeners each week in seven languages.
  
  
Building on ARN’s commitment to embracing the future and being able to provide access to the best marketing platforms in the region, MPN by Dubai Holding Entertainment is a multimedia sales house, operating premium out-of-home assets, video production, event sponsorship and activations.
  

About the Role

  
Here’s your chance to step into the role of Assistant Brand Manager at Dubai Holding Entertainment. In this role, you will support the delivery of engaging marketing campaigns, contests, events and promotional activities that strengthen the visibility of the radio stations and build meaningful connections with their audiences. Working closely with internal teams, clients, agencies and suppliers, you will help ensure every brand activation is delivered smoothly, consistently and in line with station guidelines. 
  
  
In this position, you’ll take on key responsibilities that include:
  
  

* Supporting the planning and delivery of on-air, online and on-ground campaigns, roadshows, outside broadcasts and events.
* Coordinating with sales, marketing, digital, finance, engineering and other teams to deliver station campaigns and promotional activities.
* Working with external suppliers to obtain competitive quotations, manage submissions and support cost-effective campaign delivery.
* Conducting site visits ahead of roadshows, outside broadcasts and events to confirm branding, signage and technical requirements.
* Ensuring event branding is positioned effectively in high-traffic areas and remains consistent with station guidelines.
* Managing station contests, including prizes, promotional copy, presenter mentions, liners and supporting documentation.
* Building positive client relationships and identifying opportunities for relevant competitions, giveaways and prize partnerships.
* Coordinating with the sales team to maintain a strong pipeline of prizes and promotional opportunities across the stations.
* Ensuring prizes and contest details are accurately recorded and comply with agreed confirmation forms and minimum prize guidelines.
* Managing campaigns and station activities during periods of team leave, with clear handovers to maintain continuity.
* Following established internal processes for campaign approvals, supplier quotations, documentation and barter arrangements.
* Helping maintain a consistent calendar of promotional activity that keeps audiences engaged across all station platforms.

About You

  
The ideal candidate is a proactive and organised marketing professional who understands how successful campaigns, events and promotional activities come together. You will be comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders and projects while maintaining strong attention to detail and protecting brand consistency.
  
  
You should have:
  

* A degree in Marketing or a related field, or a proven track record within a similar marketing or brand-focused role.
* Between four and six years of relevant experience in brand marketing, campaign coordination, events, media or a related area.
* A solid understanding of the elements that contribute to successful marketing campaigns and creative execution.
* Experience coordinating events, promotional campaigns, contests or on-ground brand activations.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, agencies, suppliers and internal teams.
* Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and administrative requirements simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling campaign documentation, prizes, supplier quotations and promotional content.
* Good commercial awareness, with the ability to compare quotations and identify opportunities for cost savings.
* Confidence using presentation and standard office software, including Keynote or similar presentation tools.
* Proficiency in English, with the communication skills required to engage effectively with different stakeholders.
* A customer-focused, accountable and adaptable approach, supported by initiative, creativity and sound judgement.

About the Benefits

  
In the world of entertainment, Dubai Holding Entertainment is dedicated to nurturing the talents and well-being of our team members. Join our dynamic and diverse workforce to enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive compensation, exciting career development opportunities, and a collaborative and creative work environment. We strongly believe in empowering our workforce, as they play a pivotal role in shaping unforgettable entertainment experiences for tomorrow. We are committed to attracting the brightest minds and nurturing the most innovative candidates who aspire to make a significant impact on the future of the entertainment industry in Dubai. At Dubai Holding Entertainment, we embrace equal opportunity and promote a discrimination-free environment where everyone's unique talents and contributions are celebrated. Join us in crafting a thrilling and extraordinary tomorrow in entertainment!

jobs.title: Product Manager CoreLab & Mass Spec
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
The Marketing department at Roche Diagnostics Middle East FZCO, based in Dubai and operating within Laboratory Portfolio Management (Product Life Cycle Management family), is dedicated to bridging the gap between highly technical global product specifications and local commercial execution. Working in close collaboration with Global Product Hubs, Regional Communities of Practice (CoP), and local commercial, quality, and regulatory networks, our team drives strategic portfolio initiatives, ensures strict regulatory and marketing compliance, and delivers operational excellence to protect and expand market share across critical disease areas.
  
  
We are seeking a Product Manager – Core Lab & Mass Spec specialist reporting to the Head of Laboratory Portfolio Management. In this strategic individual contributor role, you will act as the primary regional technical and operational authority for the Core Lab and Mass Spec portfolio. Leading through lateral influence without direct reporting lines, you will oversee lifecycle management, execute local pricing strategies, empower commercial teams, and provide specialized tender support to secure high-value commercial wins.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Portfolio & Lifecycle Management: Drive portfolio call-to-actions by managing product lifecycles, material introductions, and cost-effective Phase-In/Phase-Out (PiPo) transitions to ensure zero disruption to customers, align with stock and regulatory statuses, and minimize inventory write-offs
* Technical Tender Support & Revenue Protection: Act as the ultimate subject matter expert for Core Lab and Mass Spec, providing detailed technical specifications and documentation for strategic procurement submissions (especially national blood banks) to ensure technical compliance and secure revenue in high-value, multi-year tenders
* Marketing Notifications (MN) Coordination: Manage the local operational requirements for centralized marketing notifications, including customer data management, reviewing global content and translations for accuracy, executing manual distribution, and partnering with Quality, Regulatory, and Supply Chain teams to ensure all internal actions are fully completed
* Technical Training & Sales Enablement: Coordinate and deliver advanced technical product training aligned with global standards, actively engaging and motivating commercial and sales teams around complex technical requirements, pricing execution, and portfolio transitions
* Cross-Border Collaboration: Serve as the primary regional interface within Global Product Hubs and Regional Communities of Practice (CoP), providing feedback on product activations and ensuring regional needs for blood safety and infectious disease are incorporated into global product strategies
* Pricing & Solution Marketing Partnerships: Directly implement local pricing strategies during product activations and collaborate closely with Integrated Marketing Partners (B2B) to provide the technical narratives and specifications needed to build high-impact solution marketing campaigns
* Lateral Leadership & Operational Excellence: Break down functional silos to standardize processes across global hubs and local execution, leveraging authentic and courageous leadership to challenge the status quo, embrace diverse perspectives, and turn complex technical challenges into strategic opportunities

Who You Are
  
  

* Industry Experience: 5+ years of experience in product management, technical application, or specialized sales within the In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) industry, including hands-on experience managing Phase-In/Phase-Out (PiPo) strategies, pricing, and regulatory or marketing notification workflows
* Subject Matter Expertise: Deep, Customer Area (CA)-focused product knowledge in Core Lab (specifically Mass Spec), with the capability to act as the primary regional technical authority and deliver advanced technical training aligned with global standards
* Tender & Procurement Acumen: Proven experience navigating highly technical tender specifications and national procurement processes (e.g., blood bank tenders) to secure technical compliance and commercial success
* Matrix Leadership & Change Agility: Demonstrated lateral management capabilities with the ability to influence sales leaders, cross-functional teams, and global hubs without direct authority, combined with the agility to navigate ambiguity and drive new ways of working in a transforming global framework

**About the Company**

Timeless Group of Companies is a family-owned retail, distribution, trading, and investment group based in Dubai, founded in 2003. Its aim is to empower and elevate established and emerging brands in the retail world through distribution and strategic brand-building services. The group holds exclusive distribution, procurement, and master-franchise rights for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands across the Middle East and adjacent regions, reaching more than 300 GCC channels through subsidiaries including Times Square Group and J.S.K Trading Limited. The company’s values include people, honesty, creativity, transparency, operations, and leadership. You will plan sports brand activations, manage retail marketing initiatives, and coordinate digital, social, and content activity across channels. Working with internal stakeholders, agencies, and partners, you will lead cross-functional projects, manage campaign budgets and timelines, and use market research and performance analytics to identify insights and improve results. **What You'll Bring**

**Why Join Us**

At Timeless Group of Companies, you can contribute to the growth of established and emerging brands through retail, distribution, and strategic brand-building work. The group’s portfolio spans premium and luxury fashion, sports, and lifestyle, with opportunities to engage with international brands and regional market expansion. Its reach across more than 300 GCC channels gives marketing activity a connection to a broad regional distribution network. As a family-run business with more than 20 years of market legacy, Timeless combines long-standing industry experience with an emphasis on creativity, collaboration, and hands-on leadership. The company highlights career growth, training and development, and mentorship from experienced industry professionals. Its multicultural team and stated commitment to inclusion and equitable opportunity support a workplace that values different perspectives. You can work across marketing initiatives that connect brand awareness, retail activity, and commercial objectives, while collaborating with internal stakeholders, agencies, and partners. The group’s values—people, honesty, creativity, transparency, operations, and leadership—provide a clear foundation for how it seeks to build relationships and develop thriving brands.

jobs.description:
**About the role**

We're looking for a creative, confident, social-first content creator to join Nutrili in Dubai.

We don't want someone who simply manages a content calendar. We want someone who
**creates the content, gets behind the camera, and isn't afraid to be in front of it.**

Someone who lives and breathes TikTok, Instagram Reels, and digital culture. Someone who can turn everyday moments into entertaining, relatable, and engaging content that makes people connect with our brand.

You'll work closely with our founders, team, creators, and partners to bring Nutrili's personality to life.

**What you'll do**

**Create content from start to finish**

* Come up with original ideas, hooks, concepts, and scripts for Reels and TikTok.
* Film, edit, and produce short-form videos independently.
* Be comfortable appearing on camera, presenting, interviewing people, and representing Nutrili.
* Create spontaneous, entertaining content rather than relying only on planned campaigns.
* Own the weekly organic content plan and help publish content consistently.

**Bring Nutrili's people and personality to life**

* Capture behind-the-scenes moments with the team and founders.
* Develop recurring video series featuring team members, customers, and creators.
* Film product routines, relatable wellness moments, challenges, reactions, and educational content.
* Make supplements feel approachable, exciting, and relevant to everyday life.

**Get out and create**

* Attend Nutrili events, retail activations, influencer collaborations, and community gatherings across the UAE.
* Film content at locations including Spinneys, gyms, studios, wellness centers, cafés, and partner venues.
* Interview customers and capture authentic interactions.
* Work with influencers and creators to produce collaborative content.

**Understand what works**

* Stay ahead of social media trends, emerging formats, and popular content styles.
* Analyze watch time, reach, shares, saves, engagement, and follower growth.
* Test different hooks, formats, personalities, and storytelling approaches.
* Continuously improve content based on performance.

**Work with the wider marketing team**

* Coordinate with our designers and video editor to elevate production.
* Repurpose creator content for organic social.
* Support product launches and marketing campaigns with original content.
* Work with the growth team to turn customer insights and successful ad angles into organic content.

**Who we're looking for**

* A naturally creative, energetic person who enjoys making content.
* Comfortable and confident speaking on camera.
* Strong understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and creator-led storytelling.
* Able to film and edit engaging videos independently using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar.
* Strong sense of humor, storytelling, pacing, hooks, and visual taste.
* Able to work independently, take initiative, and produce content without constant direction.
* Excellent English communication; Arabic is a strong advantage.
* Based in Dubai or willing to relocate, with flexibility to attend shoots and events across the UAE.

**We're more interested in your portfolio and creativity than your years of experience or job title.**

**What success looks like**

* Nutrili consistently publishes engaging, original, video-first content.
* Our team and founders become familiar, recognizable personalities.
* We have more authentic content from our offices, events, customers, and partnerships.
* Stronger organic reach, engagement, shares, and community growth.
* Content production becomes faster, more independent, and less reliant on founders.
* We regularly produce content worth repurposing for paid ads, CRM, and campaigns.

**How to apply**

* Please share your CV and
  **a portfolio of videos you've personally created**
  , highlighting any content you've filmed, edited, directed, or appeared in.
* We'd especially love to see examples that demonstrate your personality, creativity, storytelling, and ability to make content people genuinely want to watch.

It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
  
  
**About The Role**
Ready to shape innovation and artificial intelligence products that transform how travel works for customers and colleagues?
  
  
This role is central to leading assigned innovation and AI products from discovery through proof of concept, minimum viable product, scale, or retirement. It ensures validated business and user needs are translated into clear product strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
  
  
A core part of the role is defining product vision, business cases, value hypotheses, success metrics, and backlog direction. Working across AI Engineering, Design, Engineering, data teams, and business stakeholders, the position aligns priorities and supports informed investment decisions.
  
  
You can expect to lead discovery through interviews, journey mapping, data analysis, and rapid experimentation. Partnering closely with Design, the role helps validate concepts with real users before solutions move forward.
  
  
With responsibility for product development and adoption, this position turns validated needs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, release decisions, and sustainable delivery plans. It also manages the innovation pipeline, assessing which ideas should progress, pivot, scale, or stop.
  
  
Success in this role depends on shaping trusted AI solutions with clear use cases, model success criteria, and performance measures across accuracy, latency, cost, and user trust. In addition, the role tracks product performance through KPIs, OKRs, analytics, and feedback while reporting progress, risks, and value through governance forums.
  
  
This is an opportunity to build high-impact AI products that turn bold ideas into trusted, scalable experiences and help define the next era of digital aviation.
  
  
**About You**
Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years of experience in digital product roles, including 3 to 5 years in a Product Manager role.
  
  
You are expected to possess product management certification and agile certification.
  
  
You will bring strong product discovery, experimentation, agile delivery, and AI product expertise, along with data literacy, stakeholder influence, and the ability to translate complex needs into measurable product outcomes.
  
  
This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
  
  
Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

jobs.title: Product Manager & Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Interpay**

Interpay builds the retail payment software that banks and merchants across Saudi Arabia depend on: POS and SoftPOS acceptance, e-commerce gateways, payment switching and merchant services. Our products handle cardholder data under SAMA regulation and PCI security standards, and they run around the clock.

**The role**

This is a deliberately combined role. You'll own what Interpay builds and why, based on customer needs, market demand and regulatory obligation, and do the business analysis that turns those decisions into specifications engineering can act on. The role also covers finance and credit products. You'll report directly to the CTO. Fluent Arabic is mandatory, as you'll work directly with Saudi banks, merchants and regulators.

**What you'll do**

*Product management*

* **Product definition:**
  define features from customer requirements, market demand, competitive positioning and regulatory obligation
* **Roadmap:**
  build and communicate the roadmap, balancing customer commitments, technical debt, compliance deadlines and strategy
* **Prioritisation:**
  own the backlog, and make and defend priority calls when demand exceeds capacity
* **Voice of the customer:**
  work directly with banks, merchants, payment service providers and sales to understand needs in the Saudi market
* **Market analysis:**
  track competitors, market trends and emerging payment technologies
* **Lifecycle:**
  manage features from concept to launch, iteration and retirement, with clear success measures
* **Go-to-market:**
  support positioning, collateral, pricing input, release communications and customer enablement

*Business analysis*

* Elicit and document requirements with business users, project managers and development teams
* Analyse processes and workflows, and recommend practical improvements
* Write functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria
* Run gap analyses, feasibility studies and impact assessments
* Facilitate workshops and stakeholder interviews, and give clear status updates
* Produce process models, data flows and wireframes that make requirements concrete

*Payments domain*

* Know Interpay's POS, SoftPOS, e-commerce gateway and switching products in depth
* Turn Visa, Mastercard and mada mandates into product requirements and delivery plans
* Interpret SAMA requirements, including data residency obligations
* Build PCI DSS and PCI Secure SLC implications into feature design from the start
* Specify product behaviour across authorisation, reversal, settlement, reconciliation and disputes

*Finance and credit*

* Support lending, instalment and buy-now-pay-later propositions
* Apply credit assessment, scoring and rating concepts to merchant and consumer features
* Contribute to merchant onboarding, underwriting, KYC and AML requirements
* Use interchange, merchant discount rate, settlement cycles and fee structures to shape product economics
* Partner with finance and risk so product decisions are commercially sound and well controlled

*Delivery*

* Stay with the development teams through delivery to resolve questions
* Take part in backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives
* Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria with QA, and take part in UAT
* Support training, release notes and user documentation so new features are adopted

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Finance or a related field; a Master's is a plus
* 5+ years in business analysis, product management or a combined role, with delivered product outcomes
* **Fluent Arabic (mandatory)**
  , with excellent written and verbal communication, plus professional working proficiency in English
* Payments, fintech or banking experience, with an understanding of how payment products work commercially and technically
* Requirements elicitation, process modelling, data analysis and user stories
* Prioritising competing demands and defending those calls to senior stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management with technical and non-technical audiences
* Agile delivery experience
* Jira, Azure DevOps or Confluence
* Willing and eligible to work on-site in Riyadh

**Nice to have**

* POS, SoftPOS, e-commerce gateway or payment switching products
* Lending, instalment, buy-now-pay-later, credit scoring or credit rating products
* SAMA regulation, or comparable financial regulation in another market
* mada, Visa or Mastercard scheme rules and mandates
* Merchant onboarding, underwriting, KYC and AML
* PCI DSS and its implications for product design
* SQL or analytics tools for independent data investigation
* Figma or similar wireframing and prototyping tools
* CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, Certified Scrum Product Owner or SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager
* Saudi or wider GCC market experience

**How we work**

* **Commercial judgement:**
  you weigh value, effort and risk and reach a decision you can defend
* **Analytical rigour:**
  you turn an ambiguous business problem into precise, testable requirements
* **Influence:**
  you build agreement across engineering, commercial and regulatory stakeholders without formal authority
* **Clear writing:**
  your specifications leave little room for misinterpretation
* **Domain curiosity:**
  you go deep on payments, finance and credit
* **Ownership:**
  you carry a feature from idea through launch and stay accountable for the outcome

**Where and when**

Full-time, on-site at our Riyadh office, with regular meetings and workshops. Travel to customer, partner or regulator meetings within the Kingdom may be required.

jobs.description:
**We are IMETA**

ROPU IMETA is a Regional Operating Unit consisting of 6 mid-sized Operating Units: India, Turkey, Southern Africa (South Africa & Sub Sahara Africa) Northeast & West Africa, Near East & UAE, Saudi Arabia, Gulf & East Africa (SAGEA). 
  
IMETA is home to more than 47 nationalities. We are a myriad of color and culture and embracing this diversity is one of our greatest opportunities.
  
We are a powerhouse of talent, and we work together to ensure that we grow, nurture, and retain our talent. Uniting and working together is the key to our success.

**Brand Lead IMETA – Obesity**

**Location**
: Dubai, UAE
  
**Reporting to**
: Head of Therapeutical Area Obesity & Liver Health
  
**Region**
: IMETA

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for an accomplished and commercially minded Brand Lead – Obesity to shape and drive the brand strategy across a diverse and dynamic region.
  
In this highly visible regional role, you will connect global strategic direction with local market realities, translating strategy into differentiated regional choices that unlock growth, strengthen launch readiness and enable markets to deliver sustainable brand performance.
  
Acting as a strategic partner to country teams and cross-functional stakeholders, you will bring together deep customer and market insight, strong commercial judgement and marketing excellence to define where to focus, how to win and where to invest across IMETA.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced pharmaceutical marketer who understands the complexity of the MEA/IMETA region, brings strong obesity and launch experience and has a strong ability to build alignment and drive action across diverse markets and cross-functional teams.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

•    Shape and lead the IMETA brand strategy, translating global strategic direction into differentiated regional priorities based on market maturity, customer needs, access dynamics and competitive landscape.
  
•    Identify and unlock regional growth opportunities, defining where to play, how to win and where investments and resources should be prioritized to maximize sustainable brand performance.
  
•    Generate actionable market and customer insights by leveraging HCP and patient insights, market research, competitive intelligence, brand tracking and evolving treatment dynamics across IMETA.
  
•    Lead Integrated Customer Planning across IMETA, ensuring customer plans are insight-led, aligned with brand and business objectives, and supported by clear KPIs, governance and impact measurement.
  
•    Partner with Market Access to accelerate brand growth, identifying reimbursement, affordability and patient-access opportunities and embedding access considerations into regional commercial strategy.
  
•    Lead regional launch and growth readiness for new launches, indications and lifecycle opportunities, establishing clear frameworks, milestones and readiness assessments across priority markets.
  
•    Enable and challenge country teams to translate regional strategy into strong local action plans, while strengthening marketing capabilities, sharing best practices and balancing regional consistency with local adaptation.
  
•    Shape omnichannel and customer engagement strategy, advancing segmentation, targeting, personalization and the effective use of digital, data and AI-enabled marketing capabilities.
  
•    Drive brand performance and investment effectiveness through meaningful KPIs, performance monitoring, continuous optimization and regional investment allocation based on market potential, strategic importance and expected return.
  
•    Provide strong cross-functional leadership without direct authority, aligning country and global teams around strategic priorities and representing IMETA perspectives in global discussions.

**Requirements:**

•    Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences; a Master’s degree or MBA would be an advantage.
  
•    Strong commercial experience, with at least 3–5 years of solid Brand Manager experience and demonstrated ownership of brand strategy and commercial performance.
  
•    Relevant experience in Obesity with a strong understanding of the category, customer landscape and treatment environment is a must.
  
•    Proven MEA and/or IMETA regional experience, with the ability to navigate diverse markets, healthcare systems, customer needs, access environments and levels of market maturity.
  
•    Strong strategic marketing expertise, including brand strategy, customer insights, segmentation and targeting, integrated customer planning and lifecycle management.

**City, Country: Dubai, UAE**
The Middle East is reshaping the global fragrance landscape, and Dubai is where we create for it. Join one of dsm-firmenich’s creation hubs, alongside Paris and New York.
  
  
**Why now:**
dsm-firmenich is one of the world’s leading fragrance houses, with exceptional creative, olfactive and consumer capabilities. AMET is our fastest-growing region, driven by one of the most dynamic fragrance markets in the world. As the company accelerates towards an ambitious 2027 plan, we are building a marketing team to match that ambition, and this role is central to it.
  
  
**Your impact:**
As a close partner to the Marketing Director, you will help set the foundations of how we work: methodology, key account management, and projects that put the region on the global stage. You will lead and develop two Junior Marketing Managers. You will also steer a rich, diverse client portfolio that spans prestige and niche.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Together, with our customers**

* Lead marketing for key fine fragrance accounts, turning perfumer intent and olfactive concepts into stories each client can make their own.
* Co-create with clients through ideation sessions and multi-sensory experiences that open the door to new briefs.

**Shape the future**

* Track launches, brand strategies and white spaces across the region to guide creative direction.
* Decode cultural and consumer shifts into forward-looking fragrance propositions.
* Build the reasons to believe behind each creation: perfumer inspiration, ingredients, consumer insight, innovation.

**Own the outcome**

* Coach and grow two Junior Marketing Managers, building a team grounded in trust and accountability.
* Set up shared ways of working with the Sales, Evaluation and Creation teams, so projects run on clear objectives, milestones and deliverables.

**We Offer**

* The opportunity to shape the development of AMET, our fastest-growing region, at a defining moment in its growth.

* International environment that encourages learning, collaboration and career development across businesses, functions and geographies.
