jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Marketing Manager**
=====================

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a hands-on, strategic Marketing Manager to join the AltoVita team, reporting directly to the Director of Marketing. This is a broad role for a well-rounded marketer who is comfortable switching between strategy and execution: writing an award submission in the morning, running an event logistics call in the afternoon, and challenging the marketing plan when something isn't working. We want someone who brings ideas, questions assumptions and helps shape where AltoVita's marketing goes next, as well as delivering it.

**What you will achieve in your first 6 months**
------------------------------------------------

* **Win industry recognition.** Own AltoVita's awards programme end-to-end, with a focus on our priority awards (the EMMAs and Business Travel Awards). You will select the right categories, build the evidence and write winning submissions.
* **Deliver flawless events.** Take full ownership of event execution from A to Z, including our annual Smart, Safe & Sustainable Summit, industry conferences such as GBTA, ProcureCon and the AltoLive webinar series. This covers planning, budgets, suppliers, speakers, promotion, on-the-day delivery, follow-up and ROI reporting.
* **Raise our online presence.** Sharpen AltoVita's brand awareness and thought leadership, especially on LinkedIn, by shifting toward fewer, more strategic and higher-impact posts. Grow engagement and net new followers along the way.
* **Own the quarterly Corporate Accommodation Trends Report.** Lead the research, writing, production and promotion of each edition, and turn it into a recurring thought-leadership engine across webinars, PR, social and sales.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and own the marketing content strategy, with content themes that resonate with our target audiences and align with company objectives and AltoVita's unique selling propositions.
* Shape and master the AltoVita voice on social platforms, building strong relationships with our audience, especially on LinkedIn.
* Craft compelling online and offline content, from SEO-driven and long-form pieces to thought leadership and product content.
* Identify the leading industry awards for AltoVita and write submissions ranging from 200 to 2,000 words. Manage deadlines, evidence gathering and stakeholder input.
* Research industry trends to produce whitepapers, benchmarking reports and industry reports, in collaboration with the demand and supply sectors AltoVita serves.
* Plan and run AltoLive webinars, including topics, speakers, moderation, promotion and repurposing content afterwards.
* Lead AltoVita's online and in-person event marketing, managing budgets and measuring each event's contribution to pipeline.
* Produce case studies and sales materials in collaboration with the Product, Sales and Customer Success teams.
* Contribute engaging content to email marketing, including the AltoVita newsletter and account-based marketing campaigns, in collaboration with the Director of Marketing.
* Contribute to PR initiatives by gathering data and stories for press releases and interviewing leadership and team members for news stories.
* Work closely with our in-house designer on all creative and graphic needs.
* Build cross-functional relationships to find storytelling and promotional opportunities, and support the Sales, Product, Supply and Customer Success teams with marketing initiatives that meet business objectives.
* Bring strategic input to the marketing plan. Challenge priorities, propose new channels and ideas, and use data to recommend where to invest.
* Measure marketing performance regularly across leads, pipeline influence, engagement and reach, and report insights and recommendations.
* Maintain brand standards and tone of voice across all communication channels.
* Keep learning about trends in corporate housing, serviced apartments, global mobility, business travel and hospitality.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 3+ years of B2B marketing experience across content, events and brand. Experience in hospitality, travel, global mobility or technology is strongly preferred.
* A proven track record of writing award submissions, ideally including wins.
* End-to-end ownership of events, both in person and virtual, including budgets, suppliers and ROI measurement.
* Exceptional written English with flawless grammar. Please be prepared to share writing samples.
* Experience producing research-led content such as reports, whitepapers or benchmarking studies.
* Experience growing a B2B brand on LinkedIn, with a strong grasp of thought-leadership content.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM and marketing automation platform.
* Strategic thinking combined with a willingness to roll up your sleeves, and the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Strong project management skills, consistency and attention to detail. You can juggle multiple deadlines without dropping the ball.
* A self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, remote environment with high autonomy.
* Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, including comfort moderating webinars and representing AltoVita at events.

jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Experienced Permanent ID: 101458

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Product Manager, Business Banking - Assets is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for the bank’s business banking asset portfolio. The role drives sustainable growth, profitability, customer value, and portfolio quality across lending solutions, including working capital, term finance, trade-related facilities, and secured and unsecured business loans. It leads the end-to-end product lifecycle, using market and customer insights to develop competitive propositions while ensuring effective risk, regulatory, operational, and digital delivery.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Growth**

Define and execute the business banking assets product strategy, roadmap, and annual business plan in line with the bank’s objectives and risk appetite.

Identify market opportunities and customer needs across working capital, term lending, trade-related finance, and secured and unsecured business loans.

Own portfolio KPIs covering origination, utilization, balances, revenue, margin, risk-adjusted returns, customer penetration, and portfolio quality.

**Product Development & Lifecycle Management**

Lead the end-to-end design, approval, launch, enhancement, and rationalization of asset products and propositions.

Develop product features, pricing, eligibility, collateral, tenor, and channel propositions that balance customer value, competitiveness, profitability, and risk.

Maintain product programmes, policies, procedures, customer documentation, and governance approvals.

**Commercial Performance & Distribution**

Partner with relationship management, sales, segments, and channels to build pipelines, improve conversion, and deepen customer relationships.

Develop campaigns, sales tools, training, and performance insights to support disciplined portfolio growth.

Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback and translate insights into product actions.

**Risk, Compliance & Portfolio Quality**

Work with Credit Risk to define credit parameters, underwriting criteria, portfolio limits, and risk-based pricing.

Monitor arrears, delinquency, concentration, early-warning indicators, and emerging risks, and implement corrective actions.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, conduct standards, internal policies, and product-governance frameworks.

**Digital, Process & Customer Experience**

Lead digitization and process-improvement initiatives across origination, fulfilment, servicing, and renewals.

Use customer journeys and operational data to reduce turnaround time, remove friction, and improve service quality.

**Stakeholder & Delivery Management**

Lead cross-functional delivery with Credit Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Distribution.

Prepare business cases, requirements, implementation plans, and management updates, ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes.

Manage relevant external partners and vendors and represent the portfolio in governance forums.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification or MBA is preferred.

Minimum 8 years of relevant banking experience, including at least 5 years in business banking, SME or commercial lending product management.

Demonstrated experience managing asset products across the full lifecycle, from proposition design and governance through launch and performance optimization.

Strong knowledge of lending structures, pricing, credit assessment, collateral, portfolio risk, and the regulatory environment.

Proven ability to develop business cases and interpret financial, customer, market, and portfolio data.

Strong stakeholder leadership, communication, negotiation, and programme-delivery capabilities.

Proficiency in Excel and data-visualization tools; knowledge of SQL or other analytics tools is an advantage.

jobs.description:
**1. Role Purpose**

Responsible for planning and executing marketing activity across an assigned portfolio of two to three automotive brands. Works in close coordination with the Group Marketing Manager and collaborates with Marketing Executives to deliver campaigns on brief, on time, and within budget while maintaining strong independent marketing judgment and full accountability for brand-level results.

**2. Responsibilities & KPIs**

**Campaign Planning & Execution**

• Develop brand-level marketing plans for assigned brands in line with the group strategy and commercial objectives set by the Group Marketing Manager

• Execute all approved campaigns across digital, social, events, promotions, and in-showroom channels; ensure every activation is delivered on brief, on time, and within budget

• Coordinate with Marketing Executives on content production, asset delivery, and campaign support; provide clear direction while noting that Executives report to the Group Marketing Manager

• Manage new model launches and brand activations end-to-end, from planning through to post-activation reporting, in coordination with Brand Managers and the sales team

**Internal Capability & Agency Coordination**

• Author all agency briefs internally before any external engagement; briefs must define objectives, audience, key message, channel plan, budget, and success criteria — verbal-only or agency-led briefs are not acceptable

• Maintain full independence in evaluating agency outputs — assess creative work, media plans, and campaign proposals on their own merit without relying on the agency to explain or justify them

• Manage day-to-day agency and supplier relationships for assigned brands; review deliverables critically and escalate underperformance to the Group Marketing Manager with a clear assessment and recommendation

**Digital Marketing & Lead Generation**

• Plan and manage paid search, paid social, display, and organic campaigns for assigned brands; monitor performance daily and optimise continuously for lead volume and cost efficiency

• Track and report lead generation performance by brand, campaign, and channel; provide weekly updates to the Group Marketing Manager and flag issues proactively

• Manage social media content calendars and community engagement for assigned brands, ensuring content quality, consistency, and audience relevance

• Support SEO, website content updates, and landing page optimization in coordination with the relevant agency and the Group Marketing Manager

**Sales & Commercial Alignment**

• Coordinate closely with Brand Managers and the Sales Manager to ensure campaign activity directly supports showroom traffic, test drive volumes, and retail sales targets

• Support upselling campaigns — including insurance, accessories, tinting, and warranties — and track their contribution to sales outcomes

• Provide the sales team with timely marketing collateral, digital assets, and promotional materials aligned to active campaigns and product priorities

**Reporting & Performance**

• Prepare regular campaign performance reports for assigned brands covering lead volumes, cost per lead, engagement metrics, and ROI; present findings with clear conclusions and recommended optimizations

• Monitor competitor marketing activity across assigned brand segments and share insights with the Group Marketing Manager

• Maintain accurate records of campaign budgets and vendor activity for assigned brands in coordination with Procurement and Administration

**3. Qualifications & Skills**

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field

• 5–7 years of marketing experience, with at least 2 years managing multiple brands or product lines simultaneously

• Experience in automotive, retail, or consumer brand marketing in the GCC market is strongly preferred

• Demonstrated hands-on capability in digital marketing-paid media, social media, SEO, content, and performance reporting

• Proven ability to brief, manage, and evaluate agencies independently without relying on agency-led direction

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage concurrent brand campaigns without loss of quality

• Proficiency in Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, Google Analytics, CRM platforms, and content management systems

• Professional certifications in digital marketing (Google, Meta, HubSpot, or equivalent) are an advantage

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Introducing Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain, an extraordinary addition to Raffles Hotel's renowned portfolio. This ultra-luxury property offers a unique experience as "The Palace of the Secret Garden." With 78 private pool villas ranging from 1 to 3 bedrooms, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain redefines luxury hospitality in Bahrain. Our spacious villas, starting from 400 sqm, feature private pools and jacuzzis, providing guests with ultimate relaxation and privacy. Our dedicated team of Raffles Legendary Butlers ensures exceptional service and attention to detail, creating unforgettable moments for each guest. Conveniently located just 40 minutes from the airport and 30 minutes from the City Center, Raffles Al Areen Palace Bahrain offers easy access to Exhibition World Bahrain, Bahrain International Circuit (BIC), and the Al Dana Amphitheater, making it an ideal choice for cultural, entertainment, and business destinations.
  
  
**Job Description**
****Key Responsibilities:****

* Leadership & Strategy Development: Lead and develop the overall marketing strategy in alignment with Raffles’ Bahrain business goals. Manage the marketing department, ensuring effective execution of all marketing initiatives and campaigns across digital, traditional, and experiential channels.
* Brand Vision & Positioning: Oversee and refine the brand’s positioning, ensuring consistency and alignment with the company’s mission, values, and target market. Drive brand awareness and maintain a strong brand identity across all platforms and touchpoints.
* Integrated Marketing Campaigns: Develop and implement integrated marketing campaigns to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention. Ensure that all marketing campaigns are cohesive, well-executed, and deliver measurable results.
* Digital Transformation: Lead the digital marketing efforts, ensuring a robust online presence through SEO/SEM, social media, content marketing, email campaigns, and paid media. Foster innovation in digital marketing practices and lead the company’s digital transformation initiatives.
* Market Research & Insights: Leverage market research, data analytics, and customer insights to stay ahead of industry trends, understand audience needs, and identify opportunities for growth and market penetration.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with senior leadership, sales, and revenue management teams to align marketing efforts with revenue goals and business objectives. Ensure strong communication and collaboration across departments.
* Budget & Resource Management: Develop and manage the marketing budget, ensuring cost-effective use of resources to maximize ROI. Optimize resource allocation across all marketing initiatives.
* Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and inspire a high-performing marketing team. Promote a culture of creativity, collaboration, and innovation. Provide guidance and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for marketing-related matters, presenting strategy, updates, and results to senior executives and stakeholders.
* Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Track, analyze, and report on the performance of all marketing campaigns. Provide actionable insights to continuously improve and optimize marketing efforts.
* Public Relations & Brand Partnerships: Manage public relations strategies and work with key partners, influencers, and media outlets to expand brand reach and maintain a positive brand reputation.
* Sustainability Integration: Ensure that marketing initiatives align with the company’s sustainability goals by promoting eco-friendly and ethical practices through marketing strategies.

**Sustainability:**
Commit to and maintain sustainable practices by enhancing resource efficiency, minimizing waste, and promoting eco-friendly, social, and ethical initiatives. Align with the hotel’s broader ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) and CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) objectives to drive a positive impact across all pillars of sustainability.
  
  
**Compliance and Standards:**
Ensure full compliance with local legal requirements, international standards, health and safety regulations, company policies, ISO standards, and industry best practices. Continuously review and update operational processes to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Qualifications & Skills:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. MBA or equivalent advanced degree is highly preferred.
* Experience: Minimum of 10 years of marketing experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, preferably in the hospitality, luxury, or service industry.
* Leadership Skills: Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing large teams, influencing cross-functional teams, and driving organizational change.
* Strategic Thinking: Exceptional ability to think strategically and translate business goals into effective marketing initiatives and campaigns.
* Digital Marketing Expertise: Deep knowledge of digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, social media marketing, content marketing, and email marketing.
* Creativity & Innovation: A forward-thinking, innovative mindset with the ability to develop creative marketing solutions that drive brand growth and engagement.
* Analytical & Data-Driven: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, measure campaign performance, and make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent Communication: Superior verbal and written communication skills, capable of articulating marketing strategies and results to senior leadership and external partners.

Additional Information
  
  

* Opportunity to join the first Raffles in Bahrain
* Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
* Learning programs through our Academies
* Opportunity to develop your talent and grow within your property and across the world!
* Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
